programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: Den unge, israeliske Yossi Ghinsberg lamnar en trygg framtid bakom sig for folja en osannolik drom som for honom in i Amazonas regnskogs mystiska djup.. Under ett års tid gor han en resa som många innan honom har gjort men nar han blir bekant med två andra aventyrare, Kevin Gale och Marcus Stamm och de tre moter den morka och karismatiske Karl Ruchprecter foljer de med honom in i djungeln. Vad som borjar som forverkligandet av en drom forvandlas snart till ett hemskt och psykologiskt test av fortroende och mod. Den sanna historien om att overleva mot alla odds, baserad på Yossi Ghinsbergs memoarer.

programme.title: Saints and Soldiers
programme.desc: I mitten av december 1944 rycker Hitlers arme fram genom Ardennesskogen in i Belgien. Furir Nathan Greer och hans nara van Gordon Gunderson blir liksom hundratals andra amerikanska soldater tillfångatagna av nazisterna mitt ute på ett kallt och snotackt falt. Allt eftersom utbryter panik och forvirring nar de tyska soldaterna borjar skjuta de amerikanska fångarna. Greer, Gunderson och en handfull andra soldater lyckas fly undan tyskarna. Utan varken vapen eller mat går de en hård och kall vinter till motes i hopp om att hitta tillbaka till det område dar de allierade befinner sig. En lång och mycket farlig vandring borjar.

programme.title: Saknad i strid 2 (Missing in Action 2: The Beginning)
programme.desc: Actionstjarnan Chuck Norris återvander som overste James Braddock i denna intensiva, actionfyllda prequel till den ursprungliga succefilmen. Nar kriget rasar i Vietnam blir Braddock och hans man tillfångatagna under en raddningsoperation i luften och fangslade av den hansynslose overste Yin (Soon-Tek Oh), som inte kommer att stoppa for något for att bryta deras anda! For Braddock ar valet klart: han måste befria sina medfångar och forstora lagret! Med navar, kraftiga sprangamnen och ren mod blir han en arme for sig sjalv!

programme.title: Programmet fortsatter strax
programme.desc: Vi tar igen vår skonhetssomn! Stanna kvar for mer prisvard underhållning utvald av Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Cold Zone
programme.desc: En storm ar på vag. Ingen kan forutsaga den. Ingen kan mata dess storlek. Nu måste en familj overleva den. Och ingen kan soka skydd från stormen, ingen kommer in från kylan…

programme.title: Transference
programme.desc: Josh ar alltid på sin vakt, konstant paranoid och lever ett valdigt anstrangt liv. Allt pga att han håller sin valdigt storda syster gomd i en hemlig bunker, for att hemlighålla hennes overnaturliga krafter ifrån omvarlden. Nar hon en dag blir sjuk tvingas Josh anlita en vetenskapsman for att sakerstalla hennes halsa. Det blir ett odesdigert beslut som leder till att hennes superkrafter nu avslojas.

programme.title: Joyride
programme.desc: Jon ar en forkrossad men andå charmig odugling i nastan allt han foretar sig, Luke ar en mastare på att kora bil och på flykt från sitt forflutna och Keira ar drive-thru-bitrade på ett burgerstalle och veganaktivist. Tillsammans bildar de tre en trio tillfalliga banditer nar de reser genom hela Nya Zeeland i en "lånad" gul Mini Cooper och ifrågasatter samhallets likriktning och jagar forlorad karlek med ett massivt polisuppbåd och varsta mediacirkusen hack i hal.

programme.title: Udda eller jamt
programme.desc: Polisen har misslyckats med att krossa ligan som svarar for den illegala spelverksamheten i Florida. Marinofficeren Johnny Firpo (Terence Hill) tar over uppdraget och raknar med hjalp av ex-spelaren Charlie Firpo (Bud Spencer). Det udda paret visar sig vara halvbroder, men Charlie vill andå inte hjalpa Johnny. Inte forran denne ljuger ihop en historia om att deras far ar blind och måste genomgå en dyr operation. Charlie inser att han måste tjana ihop till operationen genom ett antal poker- och spelvinster. Som vanligt får paret också många tillfallen att utnyttja sina stenhårda navar!

programme.title: Wild Target
programme.desc: En klumpig yrkesmordare blir foralskad i sitt offer och måste skydda henne från både sin egen organisation och polisen.

programme.title: Legal Action
programme.desc: Stjarnadvokaten Casey McKay lockas till en liten stad av sin exfru for att forsvara hennes bror som står åtalad for att ha mordat en distriktsåklagare. Casey blottlagger en konspirationsharva som staller honom oga mot oga med mr Gates, stadens allra mest korrupte markexploator. En f.d. marinsoldat hjalper Casey i konflikten nar det står klart att han behover mer an sitt juridiska kunnande for att hålla sig vid liv och radda sin klient.

programme.title: TMNT
programme.desc: Splittra; råttan sensei; kanner att hans fyra tonåriga skoldpaddslarjungar har vuxit isar och behover knyta an for att besegra ett uråldrigt monster.

programme.title: Spaghettiman
programme.desc: Clark saknar empati for allt och alla. Han skiter fullstandigt i varlden vi lever i och bryr sig knappt om sig sjalv heller. Men efter en incident med en gammal gryta fylld av spaghetti och en trasig mikro går nått fullstandigt snett. Clark forvandlas till en superhjalte som kan bekampa kriminalitet med hjalp av spaghetti. Men det finns en hake, du måste betala honom.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Den italienska westernstjarnan Bud Spencer (hans riktiga namn ar Carlo Pedersoli) spelar en godhjartad men jarnnavad bananodlare som bor i en liten djungelby. Ett stort bananforetag vill exploatera byn, och nar Joe satter sig på tvaren bestammer sig foretagsledaren – en gangster – att satta dit honom. Resultatet ar ett komiskt aventyr med många energiska slagsmål.

programme.title: Supersnutarna
programme.desc: De alskar fighter och planerar ett stort rån - och de ar filmnes hjaltar!Det har bara gått fem minuter av denna actionkomedi då Terence Hill och Bud Spencer redan forstort tre amerikanska vrålåk och spoat upp deras agare. Matt Kirby (Hill) och Wilbur Walsh (Spencer) ar två hårdslående bråkmakare, men med hjartat på ratta stallet. Efter ett misslyckat rånforsok i Miami hamnar de av misstag på stadens polisskola. Trots att de har svårt att skilja på ratt och fel klarar de utbildningen och utses till motorcykelpoliser. De gor sitt basta for att bli utsparkade ur poliskåren, men hur hårt de an anstranger sig går de ur varje fight som hjaltar!

programme.title: Daughter of the Wolf
programme.desc: Exmilitaren Clair Hamilton (Gina Carano) återvander hem från sin tjanstgoring nar hennes pappa nyligen har avlidit, och hamnar då på kant med sin 13-årige son Charlie (Anton Gillis-Adelman). Nar ryktet om Clairs stora arv sprids blir Charlie kidnappad och tagen som gisslan av den mystiske ”Fadern” (Richard Dreyfuss). I ett desperat forsok att radda sin son tar Clair kidnapparen Larsen (Brendan Fehr) till fånga, och tvingar honom att leda henne langs en farlig vag upp i bergen.

programme.title: The Villainess
programme.desc: Yrkesmordaren Sook-hee tar hamnd på de man som dodade hennes make. Efter att ha forlorat medvetandet vaknar hon upp hos den nationella sakerhetstjansten som vill att hon ska ta an sig topphemliga uppdrag. Sook-hee bestammer sig for att acceptera sin nya identitet som Yeon-soo for att hålla sig vid liv. Hon moter Hyun-soo och de borjar dromma om att starta en familj. Men på deras brollopsdag blir hon tilldelad ett uppdrag som kommer att forandra allt.

programme.title: The Condemned 2
programme.desc: Nar han misslyckas med att fånga ledaren for en dodlig spelring blir prisjagaren Will Tanner den jagade — ett manskligt mål i ett spel dar de som ar med måste doda eller bli dodade.

programme.title: Programmet fortsatter strax
programme.desc: Vi tar igen vår skonhetssomn! Stanna kvar for mer prisvard underhållning utvald av Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Final Shot
programme.desc: Lonnmordaren Frank har lagt sitt tidigare arbete på hyllan och forsoker leva ett till synes vanligt liv tillsammans med flickvannen och hans dotter. En dag kommer en okand maffia boss forbi for att få Franks hjalp att ha ihjal den som tagit livet av hans unga dotter. For att inte dra in sin egen familj i eventuella komplikationer måste Frank fatta ett beslut om att gora stoten åt bossen eller få ro med sin egen sjal?

programme.title: Sightings
programme.desc: Ett science fiction-mysterium om en dysfunktionell familj som bor på en ranch i Texas och hotas av en varelse i skogen. For att kunna overleva hotet måste de samtidigt losa sina egna inre konflikter.

programme.title: Cold Zone
programme.desc: En storm ar på vag. Ingen kan forutsaga den. Ingen kan mata dess storlek. Nu måste en familj overleva den. Och ingen kan soka skydd från stormen, ingen kommer in från kylan…

programme.title: Triassic Hunt
programme.desc: Nar två genetiskt framtagna dinousarer rymmer från laboratoriet kallas en styrka legosoldater in for att fånga dem. Men nar soldaterna inser att dinousarerna ar lika smarta som manniskor borjar en katt och råttalek utan dess like.

programme.title: Udda eller jamt
programme.desc: Polisen har misslyckats med att krossa ligan som svarar for den illegala spelverksamheten i Florida. Marinofficeren Johnny Firpo (Terence Hill) tar over uppdraget och raknar med hjalp av ex-spelaren Charlie Firpo (Bud Spencer). Det udda paret visar sig vara halvbroder, men Charlie vill andå inte hjalpa Johnny. Inte forran denne ljuger ihop en historia om att deras far ar blind och måste genomgå en dyr operation. Charlie inser att han måste tjana ihop till operationen genom ett antal poker- och spelvinster. Som vanligt får paret också många tillfallen att utnyttja sina stenhårda navar!

programme.title: Shockwave
programme.desc: Nar en massiv vulkanisk storm drabbar varlden forsoker geofysikern Kate Ferris overtyga forsvarsdepartementet att det inte ar ett naturligt fenomen. Det ar resultatet av ett seismiskt supervapen, kant som Hell Storm, som aktiverats. Kate måste komma på ett satt att stoppa chockvågen innan den hotar manskligheten.

programme.title: Delta Farce
programme.desc: En trio klumpiga vanner misstas for soldater och satts på ett plan till Irak. Men efter att ha kastats ut på vagen befinner de sig overgivna i en by ar i desperat behov av hjalp. Kan de bli hjaltar på riktigt?

programme.title: American Exit
programme.desc: Charlie Bond står infor ett vagskal i livet. Han har nyligen separerat från sin fru och blir ombedd att ta hand om deras son Leo over helgen. Illa tajmat då han just ar i fard med att iscensatta en konstkupp for lite snabba pengar. Leo ar helt ovetandes om planen och bara ser fram emot att får spendera tid med sin efterlangtade pappa. Tatt inpå kommer verkligheten snabbt ikapp Charlie som nu ar i allra hogsta grad en jagad man av skoningslosa torpeder. Hans enda hopp ar att lyckats fly ut ur landet och att få återstalla sin relation till Leo som han vanskott i alla år.

programme.title: Texas Red
programme.desc: Den sanna historien om legendariske Texas Red, en afroamerikansk man som vildsint jagades utmed prariens sargade landskap av hundratals laglosa cowboys genom Mississippis vintervildmark. Allt for att lagga beslag på den hogst eftertraktade beloningen.

programme.title: The Fourth Musketeer
programme.desc: På uppdrag av sin far reser den unge dArtagnan från landsbygden i Gascogne till Paris, dar han blir indragen i en listig och mycket komplicerad komplott mellan kungens musketorer och kardinal Richelieus gardister. Blod ska spillas, och den som inte ar på sin vakt kommer få satta livet till.

programme.title: 12 Rounds 3: Lockdown
programme.desc: WWE-superstjarnan Dean Ambrose spelar Shaw, en polis som återvander till aktiv tjanst efter partnerns dod. Nar han upptacker bevis som kopplar hans kolleger till mord, satter de dit honom for ett mord han inte har begått.

programme.title: Windtalkers
programme.desc: I det brutala slaget vid Saipan under andra varldskriget vaktar sergeant Joe Enders (Nicolas Cage) – och blir van med – Ben Yahzee (Adam Beach), en ung Navajo som ar tranad i den enda krigskod som aldrig brutits av fienden... Navajo-koden. Men om Yahzee skulle falla i fiendens hander, hur långt ar Enders beredd att gå for att radda militarens maktigaste hemlighet? John Woo regisserar detta actionfyllda epos inspirerat av den sanna historien om Navajo-soldaterna, vars mod och uppoffringar hjalpte till att vinna kriget i Stilla havet.

programme.title: Snedseglarna
programme.desc: Alan (Terence Hill) ar en obotlig gambler som en dag spelar bort maffians pengar och måste fly for livet. Han hinner dock få med sig sin farbrors hemliga skattkarta och gommer sig på jordenruntseglaren Charlies (Bud Spencer) båt. Alan trixar med kompassen och snart når det udda paret den paradisiska soderhavso dar skatten ar nedgravd.Har finns emellertid också fientliga infodingar, manniskojagare och en japan som fortfarande tror att andra varldskriget pågår for fullt. Alan och Charlie slåss mot dem alla och har de ingen annan att fightas mot — ger de sig på varandra! Det farsartade aventyret ”Snedseglarna” visas nu for forsta gången i oklippt originalversion.

programme.title: TMNT
programme.desc: Splittra; råttan sensei; kanner att hans fyra tonåriga skoldpaddslarjungar har vuxit isar och behover knyta an for att besegra ett uråldrigt monster.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 The U.S. East Coast, Surf And Turf
programme.desc: New Hampshire has only 19 kilometers of coastline and short summers, all the more reason Shauna Fraser takes every opportunity to be by the sea. In the sheltered harbor of Rye, Shauna also targets inner attitude with yoga on a paddleboard.

programme.sub-title: S02 : E19 Wildlife Nannies: Eagles, Owls and Hawks
programme.desc: There are eagles, owls and hawks that need individual care at Fawn Wildlife Haven Rehab, Odessa.

programme.desc: Two badgers keep their nanny busy. They must get used to the wilderness and the sounds of other wild animals.

programme.desc: Baby Gibbon Kim broke her arm and is recovering, but the arm has to heal fully before she can join her family.

programme.desc: A day with the animals of Aiderbichl, Salzburg, where badly-treated animal are rescued and shown a happy life.

programme.desc: Storms at the North Sea cause many seal pups lose their families. One nanny is on a mission to rescue a pup.

programme.title: Wildlife Nannies
programme.sub-title: S02 : E17 Wildlife Nannies: Mustang Zibby, the "Zorse"
programme.desc: Mustang Zibby is a “zorse“, half zebra half horse. Can she be trained and find her place in the mustang herd?

programme.title: Wildlife Nannies

programme.desc: Wild Arc is a 24/7 animal ER taking in injured animals from all over Vancouver island - a really tough job.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 The Secret World of Herbs - In Latin America
programme.desc: Healing effects, fragrance, and intense flavor – the benefits of herbs were discovered by the indigenous peoples of South America long before Spanish conquistadores subdued the continent. Even today, in the remote regions of South America, life without herbs is unthinkable. For many inhabitants, they provide the sole medicine. For more than two thousand years, this wisdom of the healing powers of nature has been passed down from generation to generation. In Bolivia, the film accompanies ethnobiologist Rainer Bussmann on one of his expeditions documenting which herbs the locals use against which illnesses. The German scientist has spent the last 15 years in the region, focussed on...

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 The Secret World of Herbs - In the Alps
programme.desc: Secluded for many centuries in inaccessible valleys, the inhabitants of the Alps had no alternative but to rely on the healing powers of nature. A knowledge of herbs was deeply rooted in these mountain-dwellers’ everyday lives – until the twentieth century, when this wisdom became eclipsed by modern academic medicine. Today, Alpine herbs are witnessing a revival, as public interest in regional natural treasures grows. The potential of Alpine herbs is far from exhausted. In the Berchtesgaden Alps, the film shows Hubsi Ilsanker at work as a root-digger, a back-breaking job that has scarcely changed in four hundred years. Authorized by a special historic permit to supply the oldest gentian...

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 The Secret world of Herbs - In the Balkans
programme.desc: In the pristine nature and mild climate of southeastern Europe grows a unique diversity of wild plants. Far removed from major industry and polluted soils, the Balkan countries have become the largest exporter of herbs in Europe. In Bulgaria alone, more than 300,000 people work with domestic plants. The business is becoming increasingly lucrative. The film takes us to the Croatian coast. On the Adriatic island of Cres, the audience meets Mladen Dragoslavić. In May, when the sage begins to blossom, this beekeeper has one month to produce his income for an entire year – always with the goal of creating the best sage honey in the Balkans. Given a choice, the bees would never choose sage, for...

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers - An American Journey
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Through Utahs Canyons to Salt Lake City
programme.desc: It’s a dream route leading from the casino metropolis of Las Vegas, to Salt Lake City, the Mormon capital. It is a journey that follows the footsteps of the first settlers: the Mormons. They came to this desert belt of the United States during the second half of the 19th century to escape persecution and in search of the promised land. Some of them founded Las Vegas. Others moved through the canyons and over the mountains of the colossal Colorado Plateau, where they found water and pasture, to establish many small settlements. The landscapes through which they trekked, had and still have, a breathtaking and bizarre majestic beauty. Bryce Canyon, the hogbacks and the Escalante Staircase...

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers - An American Journey
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Through Louisiana Along the Mississippi
programme.desc: The vast Delta of the Mississippi River is the gateway to the South of the United States. It always has been. This is where our journey begins: through Louisiana along the banks of the mighty river, to the big inland city of New Orleans, founded long ago by the French. Further inland, sugarcane plantations and the villas of their former owners stretch as far as the eye can see. To the north, we leave the river and, taking spectacular roads, we pass through the swamplands of the Mississippi, which were once impenetrable, serving as the ideal hideout for many a runaway. Bordering Texas, where the swamplands end, is the beginning of the vast cattle country. This is home to the last remaining...

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers - An American Journey
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Along the Shores of the Great Lakes
programme.desc: The Great Lakes are among the most mythical landscapes of North America: endless water, endless forest. Many Native American peoples lived there; later European settlers followed on the heels of the white hunters and trappers. They hunted in the forests and transported their furs and other goods across the water to the south where a small river situated at the southern tip of Lake Michigan flows onward towards the southern states. The settlement that sprung up there was called Checagou by the Indians. Much later, the settlement was to be the first skyscraper city in the world: Chicago, the megacity on the Great Lake.

programme.title: Secrets of the Mediterranean
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Secrets of the Mediterranean, Ep.1
programme.desc: The contours of the Mediterranean have changed during the course of its history. Near Gibraltar, Africa was once connected to the European continent. When the land bridge at Gibraltar collapsed, the Mediterranean basin filled up again. The Suez Canal is today connected to the Red Sea. This route enables animals to reach the Mediterranean, where they cause problems.

programme.title: Secrets of the Mediterranean
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Secrets of the Mediterranean, Ep. 2
programme.desc: Rugged rocks, blue sea and idyllic, sandy beaches - this is the Mediterranean as we know it. But this impression is deceptive: the Mediterranean is under constant change. The continents are moving towards one another. Animals, that have to survive under such extreme conditions, must find a way to escape the dangers. Between deserts and volcanoes, the challenges for the animals are enormous.

programme.title: Germanys Wild Amazon
programme.desc: As one of Germany’s beauties, the river was the gem of Germanys landscape. But with industrialization it became the country’s hardest working river and like everything that has been overworked, it lost it magnificence and charm. Due to tender love and care, the river is now a reigning example of one of the most successful and outstanding renaturation projects in the country.The film shows never before seen shots of the river now pulsing with life. We will show you the winding river bed, spawning salmon, mating crabs and still-growing anchor ice. You will see dipper birds searching for food under water, kingfishers catching fish, a family life of badgers, foxes and a wide variety of birds....

programme.title: Germanys Wild Reservoirs

programme.title: Germanys Mystic Forest

These forests and rivers, together with heathlands and moors, are home to a diverse fauna. Martens, badgers, wild boars, hares, roe deer, and red deer, even black grouse and hazel deer find shelter in these parts. Climb underground into the Bergisches Land, through the vast hidden cave systems that sprawl far beneath the forests. There is also much to be discovered...

programme.title: Northern Woods
programme.desc: It is a musical film a a tributeto the Nordic forest: it shows its development from a primeval wood to a cultivated forest. Once populated by wild animals such as wolves, bears, eagles, deer and musk oxen, complex re-enactment-scenes shot by dollies and helicopters vividly depict the colonization of the forest by the Celts and Germans. But as time progressed, the northern forest has on numerous occasions fallen victim to environmental degradation and overexploitation. Several provisions were made to protect this wild beauty. programme.title: Poppys Promise - Secret Life in a Cornfield
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. The spectacular visuals filmed with state of the art equipment introduce the surprisingly large diversity of field inhabitants. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? Why are some cornfield inhabitants harmful and others useful and what do the colourful flowers at the edge of the field...

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 The Secret World of Herbs - In Provence
programme.desc: Its native fragrant flowers and aromatic herbs have made the Provence a brand known worldwide. The wealth of flora found in this region, between the French Alps and the Mediterranean, is unequalled among the French provinces. Around Sault, near Mont Ventoux, the valleys and high plains are carpeted with bright violet: In the hot climate of the South of France, lavender blooms and exudes its fragrance. Monastic healers have been using its aromatic medicinal oil since the Middle Ages. And today an entire industry is based on the trade with this fragrant flower. Yet the livelihood of Provençal lavender farmers is imperiled. In France’s major lavender-growing region, the “Plateau de...

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 The Secret World of Herbs - In India
programme.desc: In India, herbs play an everyday role hardly equalled anywhere in the world. From the tropical green south to the mountains of the northern Himalayas, herbs lend fragrance to joss sticks and soaps, and flavor to the cuisine. And, above all, herbs heal. Six thousand varieties of plants are used in India, and most are harvested in the wild – where they are becoming depleted. The ever rising need for herbal medicine for the subcontinent’s 1.3 billion inhabitants comes on top of the demand of its growing middle class for herbal-based cosmetics. As a result, certain herbs have become scarce, while others have already vanished entirely. Most of the herbs in India are harvested in the wild. The...

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 The Secret World of Herbs - In Latin America
programme.desc: Healing effects, fragrance, and intense flavor – the benefits of herbs were discovered by the indigenous peoples of South America long before Spanish conquistadores subdued the continent. Even today, in the remote regions of South America, life without herbs is unthinkable. For many inhabitants, they provide the sole medicine. For more than two thousand years, this wisdom of the healing powers of nature has been passed down from generation to generation. In Bolivia, the film accompanies ethnobiologist Rainer Bussmann on one of his expeditions documenting which herbs the locals use against which illnesses. The German scientist has spent the last 15 years in the region, focussed on...

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 The Secret World of Herbs - In the Alps
programme.desc: Secluded for many centuries in inaccessible valleys, the inhabitants of the Alps had no alternative but to rely on the healing powers of nature. A knowledge of herbs was deeply rooted in these mountain-dwellers’ everyday lives – until the twentieth century, when this wisdom became eclipsed by modern academic medicine. Today, Alpine herbs are witnessing a revival, as public interest in regional natural treasures grows. The potential of Alpine herbs is far from exhausted. In the Berchtesgaden Alps, the film shows Hubsi Ilsanker at work as a root-digger, a back-breaking job that has scarcely changed in four hundred years. Authorized by a special historic permit to supply the oldest gentian...

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 The Secret world of Herbs - In the Balkans
programme.desc: In the pristine nature and mild climate of southeastern Europe grows a unique diversity of wild plants. Far removed from major industry and polluted soils, the Balkan countries have become the largest exporter of herbs in Europe. In Bulgaria alone, more than 300,000 people work with domestic plants. The business is becoming increasingly lucrative. The film takes us to the Croatian coast. On the Adriatic island of Cres, the audience meets Mladen Dragoslavić. In May, when the sage begins to blossom, this beekeeper has one month to produce his income for an entire year – always with the goal of creating the best sage honey in the Balkans. Given a choice, the bees would never choose sage, for...

programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Through Utahs Canyons to Salt Lake City
programme.desc: It’s a dream route leading from the casino metropolis of Las Vegas, to Salt Lake City, the Mormon capital. It is a journey that follows the footsteps of the first settlers: the Mormons. They came to this desert belt of the United States during the second half of the 19th century to escape persecution and in search of the promised land. Some of them founded Las Vegas. Others moved through the canyons and over the mountains of the colossal Colorado Plateau, where they found water and pasture, to establish many small settlements. The landscapes through which they trekked, had and still have, a breathtaking and bizarre majestic beauty. Bryce Canyon, the hogbacks and the Escalante Staircase...

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers - An American Journey
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Through Louisiana Along the Mississippi
programme.desc: The vast Delta of the Mississippi River is the gateway to the South of the United States. It always has been. This is where our journey begins: through Louisiana along the banks of the mighty river, to the big inland city of New Orleans, founded long ago by the French. Further inland, sugarcane plantations and the villas of their former owners stretch as far as the eye can see. To the north, we leave the river and, taking spectacular roads, we pass through the swamplands of the Mississippi, which were once impenetrable, serving as the ideal hideout for many a runaway. Bordering Texas, where the swamplands end, is the beginning of the vast cattle country. This is home to the last remaining...

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers - An American Journey
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Along the Shores of the Great Lakes
programme.desc: The Great Lakes are among the most mythical landscapes of North America: endless water, endless forest. Many Native American peoples lived there; later European settlers followed on the heels of the white hunters and trappers. They hunted in the forests and transported their furs and other goods across the water to the south where a small river situated at the southern tip of Lake Michigan flows onward towards the southern states. The settlement that sprung up there was called Checagou by the Indians. Much later, the settlement was to be the first skyscraper city in the world: Chicago, the megacity on the Great Lake.

programme.title: Secrets of the Mediterranean
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Secrets of the Mediterranean, Ep.1
programme.desc: The contours of the Mediterranean have changed during the course of its history. Near Gibraltar, Africa was once connected to the European continent. When the land bridge at Gibraltar collapsed, the Mediterranean basin filled up again. The Suez Canal is today connected to the Red Sea. This route enables animals to reach the Mediterranean, where they cause problems.

programme.title: Secrets of the Mediterranean
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Secrets of the Mediterranean, Ep. 2
programme.desc: Rugged rocks, blue sea and idyllic, sandy beaches - this is the Mediterranean as we know it. But this impression is deceptive: the Mediterranean is under constant change. The continents are moving towards one another. Animals, that have to survive under such extreme conditions, must find a way to escape the dangers. Between deserts and volcanoes, the challenges for the animals are enormous.

programme.title: Germanys Wild Amazon

But with industrialization it became the country’s hardest working river and like everything that has been overworked, it lost it magnificence and charm. Due to tender love and care, the river is now a reigning example of one of the most successful and outstanding renaturation projects in the country.The film shows never before seen shots of the river now pulsing with life. We will show you the winding river bed, spawning salmon, mating crabs and still-growing anchor ice. You will see dipper birds searching for food under water, kingfishers catching fish, a family life of badgers, foxes and a wide variety of birds....

programme.title: One Year in Norways Lofoten
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 One Year in Norways Lofoten: Episode 1
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norways Lofoten
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 One Year in Norways Lofoten: Episode 2
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: mareTV: The white wilderness in Greenlands East
programme.desc: Fjords, glaciers and the highest mountains in the Arctic: East Greenland with its spectacular nature is one of the most sparsely populated regions on earth. The people here live in extreme isolation and depend on helicopter flights for their supplies. Despite harsh conditions, the inhabitants here lovingly maintain their traditions and enjoy their outdoor leisure time even at minus 20 degrees Celsius. The town of Tasiilaq is the "metropolis" with 4,000 inhabitants and offers a very special attraction: the only ski lift on the east coast. Thomas Mikaelsen, the lift attendant, is not to be envied for his job. The only 100 meter long lift comes from Switzerland and is already 20 years old....

programme.title: Italys Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: The Sulcis Archipelago is located off the south-western coast of Sardinia and is part of the province of of southern Sardinia. The islands of San Pietro, SantAntioco and Isola Piana form the archipelago, together with several uninhabited islets and rocks form the archipelago. It belongs to the less known areas in Italy and is little developed for tourism. Nevertheless stars like Tom Cruise and Roberto Cavalli come here to enjoy the peace, seclusion and good food. The islanders are only moderately interested in these visitors, and their down-to-earth attitude has never lost.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On February 23th 2017, policemen are alerted of the disapearrance of Brigitte Troadec, her husband Pascal, and their children Sebastien and Charlotte.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Night of Horror at Devils Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case) - On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her little sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. She never came back. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed, "The Devils Plateau." Whats more, the crime scene looked like a mystical ritual ... Was it a ritual murder? Revenge? An unfortunate encounter? ...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valerie Bary Case)- On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood. According to the investigators initial findings, the 38-year-old nurses aid had been stabbed several times, seeming to validate the theory of a robbery gone wrong.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 13, 2011, two boaters retrieved a suitcase that was floating in the bay of Lorient. Inside, they discovered the tied up corpse of a man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake (CASE OF RUTH LÉGERET) - On January 4, 2006, Ruth Legeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows? Clue after clue, the Swiss polices investigation would revolve around an environment of family jealousy and financial greed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled. But surprisingly, though the highly meticulous murderer has taken care to leave no sign of his passage, the autopsy reveals traces of sperm on the victim. It will take all of the investigators intuition to pierce the mystery of this heinous crime...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators dont understand who could want the adorable hairdresser of Saint-Martin-dAblois dead. During the investigation, the work of profilers will enable them to draw a very precise portrait of the murderer...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: After an ordinary dinner, Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell suffer severe abdominal pains.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Nelly Cremel, 39, leaves her home to go jogging... never to return. Eight days later, after a vast search campaign, her body is found. Theres no doubt that its murder. The case soon ignites public opinion, even inflaming passions at the highest level of the state. The clues lead investigators on a number of trails, from the shadows of the French secret service to a manhunt for a possible sex maniac, in a case of murder most foul.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Willy Pomonti, a retired architect, is found savagely murdered in his opulent villa in La Celle-Saint-Cloud, near Paris. It soon becomes clear that the man has been tortured prior to death. At several points during this extraordinary enquiry, police will feel theyre holding the culprit... It will take them ten years to finally shed light on this particularly violent crime.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home. The man was shot in the head as he was getting into his car to go to work. A veritable execution, which at first glance doesnt square with the profile of the quiet family man. Yet behind the appearances, the investigation gradually reveals all the hate and resentment that revolved around the victim.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A man walks into a gendarmerie near Saint-Malo to report that his wife has been missing since the previous day. The couple are going through a divorce, but this mother would never have left her seven children alone! An extensive search is undertaken but the woman cannot be found. What has happened to Adeline Piet? The investigation spans several years and experiences many twists.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The corpse of Priscillia Ciatti, 14, is discovered by the side of a field, a few hundred metres from her family home. The teenager has been stabbed sixty times with a knife and -an extra sordid detail - a devil mask is found next to her body. Was Priscillia the victim of a prowler? A serial killer? A maniac inspired by a horror movie? Investigators soon find that the young girl felt she was being watched, and even threatened...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: In the early hours of the morning, Mathilde Croguennec, 18, attending "Teknival" in Brittany, is found at the foot of a tree with her throat cut. Investigators face the task of finding the killer from among the 43,000 participants of this huge open-air festival of electronic music, where drink and drugs are consumed in abundance. An unusual investigation that leads the police down a number of false avenues.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Arriving at her work, the secretary of a small firm in the suburbs of Geneva finds the body of Jean-Raymond Blatti, the companys new accountant. The man is lying in a pool of blood and, on his belly, the murderer has written "DIRTY RAPIST". Yet Jean-Raymond Blatti was never charged with sexual assault. Over the course of the investigation, this inscription will appear as one of the many mysteries of this case which is particularly rich in twists and turns.

programme.title: Science on Fire
programme.desc: Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they kindle our curiosity about the science behind fire. This week’s experiments investigate how you can burn metal using only a 9 volt battery, what fire can teach us about calories, and why a little bit of sodium can cause a gigantic explosion.

programme.title: Invisible Impacts
programme.desc: Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they shine a light on the unseen science behind our everyday lives. This week’s experiments explore the resonant frequencies of bridges and human bodies.

programme.title: Water, Water Everywhere
programme.desc: Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they dive deep into the wonderful world of water. In this week’s experiments we discover how water can start a fire, transform breakfast cereal into a magnetic field detector, and even change the way you visualize the world around you.

programme.title: Magnificent Mixtures
programme.desc: Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they amalgamate in the name of science. In this week’s experiments we mix up some fireworks made from tin foil, whip up a stinky polymer, and try out an alchemy staple - turning lead into gold.

programme.title: Up and Atom
programme.desc: Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they break open the atomic bonds that connect our world. This week’s experiments blow open the science behind creating a glowing pickle, how forensic teams extract DNA, and how acids can transform simple household items to their core.

programme.title: Hot Hot Heat
programme.desc: Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they turn up the thermostat and discover the role heat plays in science. This week’s experiments investigate how to send secret messages with heat.

programme.desc: Join host Nick Uhas and his guests discover the unstable world of elemental gasses. This week’s experiments include recreating a big bang with lithium, the incendiary power of methane, and how a little bit of liquified nitrogen can lend a lot of power to a rocket.

programme.title: Colorful Conundrums
programme.desc: Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they taste the scientific rainbow. This week’s experiments highlight how electricity can tint titanium, how you can create a color wheel by lighting things on fire, and why the world gets all its colors from white light.

programme.desc: Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they make science look like sorcery. This week’s experiments delve into the possibilities of mind control, why objects and people tend to sync together, and the magical mysteries behind magnesium.

programme.title: The Sound of Science
programme.desc: Join host Nick Uhas and his guests as they tune into the science behind sound. This week’s experiments hit high notes as we discover the physics of theremins, investigate how the outer ear impacts human hearing, and put on a laser show with cymatics.

programme.desc: In Katmai National Park, Alaska a massive population of coastal brown bears gather to eat salmon as they migrate back to the rivers and streams where they were born.

programme.title: Fish Like a Bear
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 The Trackers Diary: Bears of Katmai
programme.desc: The crew heads inland to a section of the river to observe the many different families as they fish.

programme.desc: During a lull in bear and salmon activity, Casey and the crew decide to head inland in search of the spawning fish.

programme.title: The Wolf and The Storm

programme.title: Camp X-Ray
programme.desc: Kristen Stewart spelar huvudrollen i Peter Sattlers hyllade debutfilm Camp X-Ray. Hon spelar Amy Cole, en ung kvinna som tar varvning i amerikanska militaren i tron att hon kommer att skickas till Irak eller Afghanistan. Istallet blir hon stationerad som vakt på ett okant militarfangelse, med tuffa villkor for såval basens fångar som de få kvinnliga militarer som arbetar dar.

programme.title: 30:e november
programme.desc: Adam och hans polare spenderar sin tid med att trakassera invandrare som de hatar. Men så moter Adam Julia från Peru och de blir blixtforalskad, eftersom varken Adams vanner eller Julias familj skulle acceptera att de två ar tillsammans tvingas de hålla sin karlek hemlig. På Sveriges nationaldag drabbas Adam och hans gang samman med Julias bror, Sascha, och hans vanner. Det hela slutar med att två dodads.

programme.title: Programmet fortsatter strax
programme.desc: Vi tar igen vår skonhetssomn! Stanna kvar for mer prisvard underhållning utvald av Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Mazes and Monsters
programme.desc: Robbie och hans collegekompisar ar alla besatta av rollspelet "Mazes and Monsters". Men spelen tar en marklig vandning nar Robbie borjar få visioner efter att de spelat en session på ett mystiskt, lokalt landmarke.

programme.title: The Good Heart
programme.desc: Jaques (Brian Cox – THE BOURNE IDENTITY) ager en sjaskig bar, som fungerar som ett andra hem for en brokig skara professionella drinkare. Jaques sjalv ar fast besluten att supa och roka sig till dods. Nar han moter den unge hemlose Lucas (Paul Dano – THERE WILL BE BLOOD), som också gett upp hoppet om livet, tycker han sig ha hittat den perfekte arvingen till baren. Jaques borjar lara Lucas sitt kungadomes manschauvernistiska lagar: inga nya kunder, ingen personlig kontakt med gasterna, och absolut inga kvinnor! Lucas lar sig fort, men vanskapen satts på prov då den olyckliga och vackra April (Isild Le Besco) soker skydd i baren.

programme.title: The Honor List
programme.desc: Tre fore detta basta vanner återforenas nar den fjarde medlemmen av gruppen plotsligt går bort under sista året i high school. De bestammer sig for att fullfolja den bucket list de gjorde forsta året i high school, nar de fyra annu stod varandra nara.

programme.title: The Dark Divide
programme.desc: En dramakomedi som baserar sig på verkliga handelser, med David Cross - som vi sett i serien Arrested Development, och Debra Messing - kand från serien Will and Grace, i huvudrollerna. Robert ar en fjarilsforskare vars fru insjuknar i cancer. Frun overtalar sin uppgivne man att åka på en fjarilsresa, vars ovantade moten och forvantade motgångar oppnar Roberts ogon på nytt.

programme.title: From Time to Time
programme.desc: En spokhistoria som spanner over två varldar med mer an ett sekel från varandra. Nar 13-åriga Tolly upptacker att han på ett mystiskt satt kan resa mellan de två, borjar han ett aventyr som avslojar familjehemligheter som har begravts i generationer.

programme.title: Griffin and Phoenix
programme.desc: Nar Griffin har fått diagnosen att han har dodlig cancer bestammer han sig for att ta livet i egna hander och ha lite kul innan han dor. Samtidigt som tiden for hans liv rinner ut traffar han och blir kar i Phoenix - som också har en hemlighet.

programme.title: Son of the South
programme.desc: Verklig historia om en KKK-medlems barnbarn som vaxer upp i borjan av 1960-talet. Trots att han fostrats in i hatet intresserar han sig for medborgarrattsrorelsen.

programme.title: Dont Come Knocking
programme.desc: Hollywoodstjarnan Howard Spence (Sam Shepard) har sett battre dagar. Han vilar på sina lagrar och lever på sin gamla stjarnstatus. Efter ytterligare en natt med vilda utsvavningar flyr han från inspelningen av nasta vasternfilm och rider ut på prarien och de stora vidderna precis som en av hjaltarna som han så ofta har gestaltat. Han soker tillflykt hemma hos sin mamma (Eva Marie Saint) som han inte har traffat på många år. Men inte ens dar stannar han sarskilt lange, for han får veta att han någonstans kan ha en son som han inte visste fanns. For Howard kanns det som en strimma hopp och ett bevis for att inte har levt sitt liv forgaves.

programme.title: Albert Nobbs
programme.desc: Albert ar en forsynt man som doljer en stor hemlighet, han ar egentligen en kvinna som tvingats kla och bete sig som en man for att komma bort från fattigdom. En dag moter Albert en annan manniska i samma situation och han borjar dromma om ett liv i frihet utan hemligheter. Albert Nobbs ar en stark och rorande film med en stjarnspackad rollista.

programme.title: In Tranzit
programme.desc: Baserad på en sann historia. I chockvågorna efter andra varldskriget, under den kalla vintern 1946, skickas av misstag en grupp tyska krigsfångar till ett ryskt kvinnofånglager som styrs av kvinnliga fångvaktare. Fångvaktarna, som forlorat många narstående på grund av Nazisternas brutalitet, mottar de nyanlanda fångarna med stor fientlighet och ser en mojlighet till hamnd...

programme.title: The Room
programme.desc: Trotta på det hetsiga storstadslivet och alla krav flyttar Kate och Matt in i sitt dromhus på landet. Men det gamla huset hyser sannerligen hemligheter och snart upptacker de ett val undangomt rum. Ett rum som har den fantastiska egenskapen att frammana och materialisera exakt vad de onskar sig. Dock ar ingen lycka komplett utan odesdigra konsekvenser: det som uppstår i rummet kan aldrig lamna det utan att tyna bort. Och det Kate och Matt onskar sig mest… ar ett barn.

programme.title: The Architect
programme.desc: En arkitekt hamnar i konflikt med en aktivist som bor i ett farligt komplex som arkitekten ritade.

programme.title: Programmet fortsatter strax
programme.desc: Vi tar igen vår skonhetssomn! Stanna kvar for mer prisvard underhållning utvald av Rakuten TV.

programme.title: The Truth Commissioner
programme.desc: En sanningskommissionar avslojar morka hemligheter i Nordirland, dar makt och forflutet kolliderar i kampen for rattvisa och forsoning.

programme.title: Promised Land
programme.desc: Det har dramat foljer två skolkamrater, Hancock och Danny, efter examen. Hancock och hans flickvan som ar en cheerleader ger sig ivag till medelklassens tillhåll utom rackhåll for Danny och hans psykotiska fru Bev.

programme.title: Equals
programme.desc: I en utopisk varld, dar våld och brott i princip ar utplånade via genetisk eliminering av kanslor, lever personer som Nia och Silas ett lugnt, handelselost och dronarlikt liv. De arbetar med att producera informationsmaterial på ett stort kontor och utvaxlar enbart artighetsfraser. Livet ar enkelt, anda till dess att ett rykte borjar florera: en sjukdom som orsakar att manniskor visar kanslor har brutit ut. Om det upptacks av overheten skickas de infekterade ivag, for att aldrig återvanda. Silas misstanker att han bar på sjukdomen och nar det bekraftas, blir han en paria. Trots det dras han till Nia, som också ar infekterad men har lyckats dolja symptomen battre an han sjalv.

programme.title: Shattered Glass
programme.desc: Hayden Christensen spelar huvudrollen i denna kritikerrosade berattelse om en utskamd journalist, regisserad och samskriven av Billy Ray, Oscar®-nominerad forfattare av KAPTEN PHILLIPS. Nar den beromda journalisten Stephen Glass (Christensen) plotsligt utredas av en Forbes.com-reporter (Steve Zahn) avslojar sokandet att Glass har diktat ihop många av sina sensationella berattelser, vilket leder till hans ultimata fall i detta gripande, faktabaserade drama.

programme.title: Brain On Fire
programme.desc: Susannah Cahalan har nyligen avslutat sina universitetsstudier och lever dromlivet i New York. Hon ar en lovande journalist på New York Post och foralskad i musikern Stephen. Hennes chef ger henne det stora uppdraget som ska rivstarta hennes karriar och livet kan inte bli battre. Snart borjar saker och ting gå fel. Susannah drabbas av en influensa som inte vill ge sig, hon glommer saker och missar deadlines på jobbet. Hon hor att folk pratar om henne, ar overtygad om att Stephen har en annan flickvan och hon kan inte kontrollera sin kropp. Det blir snart varre; Susannah borjar få våldsamma anfall och hennes alltmer psykotiska upptradande innebar att hon standigt måste overvakas.
En ung forfattare tvingas att acceptera sin dodlighet nar han diagnoseras med en sallsynt form av cancer. Med hjalp av sin basta van och en ung terapeut finner han modet att mota sjukdomen.

programme.title: Teen Spirit
programme.desc: Elle Fanning spelar Violet, en blyg tonåring som drommer om att fly sin hemstad och uppfylla sin drom att sjunga. Med hjalp från ovantat håll anmaler hon sig till en talangtavling som kommer satta hennes integritet, talang och ambition på prov. Ett soundtrack fullt med poplåtar ger en ny spinn på den klassiska Askungesagan.

programme.title: Auggie
programme.desc: Felix Greystone har en bit kvar till pensionsåldern, men foretaget pressar honom att gå i fortidspension. I avskedsgåva får han ett par smartglasogon, som vacker anvandarens storsta drommar till liv. Nar Felix frus karriar tar fart och dottern borjar bli sjalvstandig inser Felix hur ensam han kanner sig. For att fly den plågsamma ensamheten fordjupar Felix sig allt mer i sina smartglasogons varld, vilket påfrestar Felix relation till familjen ytterligare.

programme.title: From Time to Time
programme.desc: En spokhistoria som spanner over två varldar med mer an ett sekel från varandra. Nar 13-åriga Tolly upptacker att han på ett mystiskt satt kan resa mellan de två, borjar han ett aventyr som avslojar familjehemligheter som har begravts i generationer.

programme.title: Synchronicity
programme.desc: "Fysikern Jim Beale har uppfunnit en maskin som kommer att revolutionera varlden som vi kanner den: en tidsresemaskin som kroker rumtid. Nar Klaus Meisner, en av varldens maktigaste foretagare, får veta det så beslutar han att han till varje pris måste ha maskinen. Nar Jim med maskinen oppnar ett maskhål så dyker det upp en dahlia från framtiden. For att behålla ratten till sin uppfinning måste Jim bevisa att maskinen fungerar genom att hitta blommans identiska motsvarighet i nuet. Jim upptacker snart att dahlian ags av Abby, en mystisk kvinna som forfor honom for att han ska avsloja sina hemligheter.

programme.title: Zalava
programme.desc: 1978, i den avlagsna bergsbyn Zalava ar byborna skrackslagna infor en osynlig fara. De havdar att en demon hemsoker deras by och har anlitat en exorcist for att driva bort anden. Nar den unge sergeanten Massoud griper exorcisten for bedrageri urartar situationen av bybornas skrack och ilska.

programme.title: Amores Perros
programme.desc: Karlek ar många saker — vissa bra, andra dåliga — men framfor allt suger den. En fruktansvard bilolycka binder samman tre berattelser, var och en med karaktarer som hanterar forlust, ånger och livets hårda verkligheter, allt i karlekens namn.

programme.title: Tillbaka till Yorkshire
programme.desc: Arthur Morrison får reda på att han har cancer och att han bara har några veckor kvar att leva. Hans vuxna son Blake reser till Yorkshire for att bo hos sin mamma i byn dar han vaxte upp. Nar Arthurs tillstånd forvarras ser Blake tillbaka på sitt forhållande med pappan. Han minns saker de gjort tillsammans, fortroligheten mellan dem och aven de forbistringar de haft. Nar fadern dor borjar Morrison fundera kring det band de haft. Han ger tydligt uttryck for motsattningar, frustration, karlek och forlust som alla ar delar i det komplicerade forhållande som finns mellan en far och hans son.

programme.title: High Holiday
programme.desc: Den frisinnade Liz ar inte så sugen på att ta med sin pojkvan hem till sin konservativa familj på julmiddag. Liz pojkvan foreslår att hon ska krydda salladsdressingen med marijuana for att latta upp stamningen. Kaos uppstår nar alla blir omedvetet hoga och avslojar familjens innersta hemligheter.

programme.title: P2
programme.desc: En kvinna som jobbar sent på julafton blir tillfångatagen av en psykotisk sakerhetsvakt som ar besatt av henne. Med inga andra manniskor i parkeringshuset måste hon anvanda all sin list och styrka for att overleva och ta sig darifrån.

programme.title: Ett mirakel på Julsjon
programme.desc: Nar en tonårspojke forlorar sin basta van och sin pappa runt jul- slutar han med sin favoritsport hockey och lamnar sina vanner. Nar en isrink magiskt dyker upp på den frusna sjon nara hans hem, minns han de goda tiderna.

programme.title: En Familj Matters Jul
programme.desc: Julen ar allt annat an vanlig- nar tre kiviga syskon från ett nyblandat hushåll inte kommer overens. Den yngsta, nar han avslutar sitt årliga vetenskapsprojekt- råkar kalla på julstamningen. De vaknar och upptacker att de har bytt kroppar och inte kan forvandlas tillbaka forran de lar sig att tillbringa julen tillsammans som en karleksfull familj.

programme.title: Julens Underland
programme.desc: Jultiden i NYC ar allt annat an underbar for den kampande artisten Heidi Neill.

programme.title: Another Christmas Coincedence
programme.desc: Alice och Jack, två framlingar med totalt olika bakgrunder hamnar av en slump en helg på samma brollop. Det klickar direkt mellan dem men Alice ar tveksam till en ny relation efter ett havererat långdistansforhållande. Uppmuntrad av mamma Olga borjar Alice sakta vanja sig med tanken och borja dejta igen. Mer tillfalligheterna for dem narmare samtidigt som nya hinder avloser varann och utmanar den nyfunna romansen.

programme.title: Julmuffins
programme.desc: Nar familjebageriet kanske måste stanga strax fore jul- måste systrarna Kim och Gina tavla om att vinna det stora priset. I en varld av hårda konkurrenter och en tickande klocka- kravs det ett julmirakel for att radda bageriet. Men de kan upptacka ett pris som ar storre an de hoppats på.

programme.title: A Winter Princess
programme.desc: Efter en prestigefull gala bestammer sig prinsessan Carly for att ta ett sabbatsår och hoppa på ett for henne dromjobb vid en skidanlaggning. Ingen av hennes nya arbetskamrater kanner till hennes ratta identitet, men nar medlemmar från den kungliga slakten borjar dyka upp vid anlaggningen blir det plotsligt valdigt komplicerat att hålla på hemligheten utan att bli upptackt. Allt medan de preppar for ett 50års jubileum av anlaggningen, och Carly som borjar bli stortkar i agarens bror Jesse. Carly står nu infor stora vagval i livet och kanner sig bara alltmer forvirrad ju langre tiden går…

programme.title: Catfish-julen
programme.desc: En hjartekrossad ung kvinna återvander hem over julen- och kanner pressen av att vara singel. Hennes karleksfulla och nyfikna syster planerar en natdejt- med en stilig idrottsman. Men det tar en ovantad vandning nar han inte ar hennes "prins i skinande rustning". Hennes barndomsvan visar henne att akta karlek kan finnas narmare hemmet.

programme.title: Mr. Christmas
programme.desc: Tom har byggt en karriar att hjalpa klienter finna den perfekta presenten till sin alskade. Julruschen tar fart och hans basta van Paul ber om en tjanst att hitta en present till hans flickvan Jenny. Tom hamnar snabbt i ett dilemma nar han lar kanna Jenny battre och inser att han sjalv håller på att foralska sig i sin vans flickvan. Uppdraget narmar sig sitt slut och Tom våndas over att hans enda chans att hitta sin sjalsvan håller på att rinna ur handerna for honom.

programme.title: A Merry Holiday
programme.desc: Christy, en mycket framgångsrik forsaljare stressar over att landa en stor affar. Till sin hjalp tar hon medarbetaren Jonathan som ar upptagen med att pynta sin ungkarlslya till ett magiskt vinterland for att impa på flickvannens pappa. De kommer båda i klinch med varann, men inser att de måste samarbeta och hjalpa varandra. Ju mer tid de spenderar, desto avslappnat blir relationen dem emellan och kanske ar det inte bara jobbet som for dem samman langre?

programme.title: Jul med en Krona
programme.desc: Nar en framgångsrik kvinna återvander till sin hemstad- traffar hon en stilig framling som hjalper till att organisera evenemanget. Det slår gnistor mellan dem, men hon anar inte att han ar en forkladd prins- som langtar efter julens sanna anda. Det kravs ett julmirakel av kungliga proportioner- for att deras hjartan ska bli ett.

programme.title: High Holiday
programme.desc: Den frisinnade Liz ar inte så sugen på att ta med sin pojkvan hem till sin konservativa familj på julmiddag. Liz pojkvan foreslår att hon ska krydda salladsdressingen med marijuana for att latta upp stamningen. Kaos uppstår nar alla blir omedvetet hoga och avslojar familjens innersta hemligheter.

programme.title: P2
programme.desc: En kvinna som jobbar sent på julafton blir tillfångatagen av en psykotisk sakerhetsvakt som ar besatt av henne. Med inga andra manniskor i parkeringshuset måste hon anvanda all sin list och styrka for att overleva och ta sig darifrån.

programme.title: The Loss Adjuster
programme.desc: En forsakringsman som kampar med forlust och karlek upptacker nya mojligheter under en vecka full av ovantade handelser och komiska vandpunkter.

programme.title: Ingen nåd sa Moses (The Troublemakers)
programme.desc: Travis (Terence Hills) ar vastens snabbaste revolverskytt. Hans bror Moses (Bud Spencer) ar stor som en bjorn och dubbelt så argsint og nybyggartrakternas mest hårdfora prisjagare. Når deras kara gamla mamma beslutar att återforena sina soner till jul blir det Travis uppgift att forsoka locka med sig Moses hem…

programme.title: En tomtesaga
programme.desc: I Lappland for hundra år sedan forlorade lille Nikolas sin familj i en olycka. Byns invånare tog gemensamt hand om pojken. Varje jul flyttade han till en ny familj och for att visa sin tacksamhet gav Nikolas en gång per år presenter till familjernas barn. Men nar Nikolas fyllde 13 år tvingades han borja jobba hos Isak, en bitter snickare som forbjod honom att gora presenter...

programme.title: En perfekt jullista
programme.desc: Som en sista onskan ger en sjuk mormor sin dotter Michelle och barnbarnet Sara en lista over festliga prestationer att gora tillsammans fore jul, i hopp om att det ska reparera deras forhållande.

programme.title: Julharmoni
programme.desc: En begåvad sångerska blir forkrossad- nar hennes musikerpojkvan gor slut strax fore julhelgen. Hon återvander till sin hemstad dar hon traffar gamla vanner- och traffar en stilig ungkarl som också har upplevt hjartesorg. Tillsammans återupptacker de musik, romantik, familjeband- och julens magi.

programme.title: Jul med en Krona
programme.desc: Nar en framgångsrik kvinna återvander till sin hemstad- traffar hon en stilig framling som hjalper till att organisera evenemanget. Det slår gnistor mellan dem, men hon anar inte att han ar en forkladd prins- som langtar efter julens sanna anda. Det kravs ett julmirakel av kungliga proportioner- for att deras hjartan ska bli ett.

programme.title: En Bennett-sång Holiday
programme.desc: Familjen Bennett-Song återvander till jul med stora nyheter. Mrs Song vantar ett barn som ska utoka listan på 14 adopterade barn! Familjen måste samarbeta for att ta sig an en maktig byggherre- som vill stanga farbrors kulturhus for handikappade och utsatta barn. Lite karlek, lagarbete och julmagi kommer att radda dagen.

programme.title: Sander jul
programme.desc: Nar hennes on-air-partner bestammer sig for att lamna Amerikas favoritmorgonprogram, meddelar Veronika Daniels att hon kommer att valja sin nya medvard bland en handfull kandidater som inkluderar Charlie Fisher, en lokal nyhetsupplasare i NY.

programme.title: A Christmas Coincedence
programme.desc: Julen narmar sig med stormsteg och Paula har lite motvilligt accepterat hennes pojkvans frieri. Mormor Jane kanner att något inte står ratt till och bjuder hem henne på vischan for lite pepptalk. Paula besoker en vingård i narheten och springer in i agaren Gery. En serie tillfalligheter for dem narmare varann. Ett ovader sveper over bygden som tvingar Paula att stanna over natten, och snart kommer hon inse att just de ar menade for varann…

programme.title: Nissemannen
programme.desc: En nisse lamnas kvar av tomten for att radda familjen Harper från en usel jul. Nissen och familjen får mer an de raknade med- nar barnen hjalper nissen att upptacka sina krafter- och sin sanna identitet som en spirande superhjalte.

programme.title: Julkupong
programme.desc: En fore detta skridskomastare borjar undervisa vid sin vans damm- och delar ut "kuponger" for att locka nya elever. Nar hennes fore detta ungdomskarlek (och nu kand hockeyspelare) tar med sin brorsdotter på lektioner, tands gamla flammor på nytt, och julen fylls med en andra chans for karlek.

programme.title: Puppy Star Christmas
programme.desc: Pup Star-familjen har utokats! De nya valparna ar: Cindy, Rosie, Charlie, och Brody, som måste lara sig julens innebord. Nar Pup Stars elakingar forsoker forstora julen hamnar valparna på Nordpolen for att radda tomten och julstamningen. Deras aventyr ar fyllt av valp-tastiska sånger som sprider julgladje året om.

programme.title: A Christmas Horror Story
programme.desc: Vaver samman fem komiska berattelser om skrack och ondskefulla julandar.

programme.title: Fatman
programme.desc: I dagens minst sagt skruvade varld finns jultomten på riktigt och han ar pank eftersom det knappt finns några snalla barn nufortiden och for att regeringen vagrar hjalpa honom med hans personalkostnader nar efterfrågan sjunker och intakterna sinar. Han ar en hårdsupande hårding som ar bevapnad, for nar man flyger jorden runt så kan folk ibland få for sig att skjuta tillbaka.

programme.title: High Holiday
programme.desc: Den frisinnade Liz ar inte så sugen på att ta med sin pojkvan hem till sin konservativa familj på julmiddag. Liz pojkvan foreslår att hon ska krydda salladsdressingen med marijuana for att latta upp stamningen. Kaos uppstår nar alla blir omedvetet hoga och avslojar familjens innersta hemligheter.

programme.title: $100,000 for Ringo
programme.desc: Stranger Lee Barton rides into Rainbow Valley, mistaken for a man thought dead. As tensions rise with ruthless town boss Tom Cherry—whos after hidden gold and the affections of a local woman—Barton is drawn into violence and revenge. With a sheriffs help, he seeks justice and a new start with a boy who believes hes his father.

programme.title: Bonanza Compilation Episodes 31, 32, 33
programme.desc: The Wild West adventures of Ben Cartwright and his sons as they run and defend their Nevada ranch while helping the surrounding community.

programme.title: Mackenzies Raiders EP36-38
programme.desc: Colonel Mackenzie, commander of the 4th Cavalry Regiment at Fort Clark near Brackettville in Kinney County in southwest Texas during the 1870s, receives secret orders from President Ulysses S. Grant and Secretary of War William W. Belknap to stop bandits from crossing the Rio Grande into the United States, or from returning to Mexico.

programme.title: Against a Crooked Sky
programme.desc: The eldest daughter of a pioneer family is kidnapped by a mysterious Indian tribe and the eldest son pursues. In order to win back his sisters freedom, he must sacrifice his own life by passing the test of "Crooked Sky" and shield his sister from an executioners arrow. Along the way, he recruits a broken down, drunk prospector to help him track down the unknown tribe and rescue his sister.

programme.title: Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: In the 19th century, Maggie Sergent and her family move to Wyoming seeking a new start. But when her husband is murdered, Maggie faces a harsh choice: build a life in the unforgiving West or return to the familiar safety of the East. Tragedy, resilience, and survival collide on the frontier.

programme.title: The Great Jesse James Raid
programme.desc: Retired outlaw Jesse James, under an alias, reluctantly joins Bob Ford for a Colorado gold raid. Assembling a crew, including a demolition expert and a getaway driver, they meet at Fords saloon. Betrayals and bloodshed follow, with Ford plotting against Jesse for a reward. The drama peaks as lives are lost and the two ride off in separate directions.

programme.title: South of the Rio Grande
programme.desc: When Miguel Sanchez uses stolen cattle and false accusations to have innocents killed, Cisco steps in. After rescuing a wagon under attack, Cisco discovers the victim was meant to replace Sanchez. Disguising himself as the victim, Cisco infiltrates Sanchezs operation to uncover evidence and bring justice to the rancho.

programme.title: Cut-Throats Nine
programme.desc: A cavalry troop is escorting a wagonload of convicts on their way to prison through the mountains when they are attacked by a bandit gang. Only a sergeant, his beautiful young daughter, and an assortment of seven sadistic, murderous prisoners survive, and they are left without horses or a wagon. The sergeant must find a way to get his prisoners to their destination while protecting his daughter, watching out for the still-pursuing bandits, and trying to determine which prisoner is the man who raped and murdered his wife.

programme.title: Wyatt Earp S01E05-08
programme.desc: In one of televisions first adult Westerns, the famous marshal puts his life on the line to maintain order, first in Dodge City, Kan., then in Tombstone, Ariz.

programme.title: They Called Him Trinity
programme.desc: An ex-sheriff sets out to find the bandits who beat and murdered his sister.

programme.title: Yellow Hair and the Fortress of Gold
programme.desc: Fiery blonde half-breed Yellow Hair and her easygoing sidekick the Pecos Kid are after a fortune in Mayan gold.

programme.title: Rattler Kid
programme.desc: Falsely convicted for robbing an army treasury, Tony Garrett escapes prison and sets out to find the real criminals responsible. As he hunts for revenge, he faces dangers and uncovers dark truths, determined to clear his name and make the true culprits pay for their actions.

programme.title: The Red Pony
programme.desc: A ranch boy is gifted with a colt, grows to love him but the colt escapes, with tragic results.

programme.title: Secret of Captain OHara
programme.desc: Captain O’Hara saves Mary from Navajo warriors and brings her safely to Fort San Antonio. But her fiance, Major Brooks, is not only O’Hara’s rival but also a ruthless enemy of the Native tribes. As tensions rise, O’Hara must fight for peace while facing personal betrayal and growing conflict.

programme.title: The Django Story
programme.desc: Legendary gunslinger Django is recounting some of his greatest adventures while sitting in a saloon.

programme.title: Hate your Neighbour
programme.desc: Ken wants justice for his brother Bill, who was killed by a notorious gunman named Stevens for a goldmine map. The gunman is arguing with gangster Malone (Horst Frank) about the map. A deadly cat and mouse game between the three men ensues.

programme.title: Bury Me Not
programme.desc: Two women hide the surprising truth as a sheriff investigates a murder.

programme.title: Django the Bastard
programme.desc: A ghostlike stranger arrives to avenge a Civil War betrayal. Former Confederate officers who caused the massacre of their own unit begin to die one by one, as Django delivers chilling justice from beyond the grave.

programme.title: Billy the Kid Versus Dracula
programme.desc: Dracula arrives in the Old West, setting his sights on a young ranch owner. Her fiance, Billy the Kid, is warned of the vampire’s true nature but struggles to convince others. As Dracula tightens his grip, Billy must act fast to save his bride-to-be before it’s too late.

programme.title: The Gay Cavalier
programme.desc: The Cisco Kid embarks on a dual mission: rescuing a girl from a marriage to a false suitor and tracking down outlaws who robbed a gold-carrying stage. His task becomes clearer when he discovers that the so-called wealthy suitor is secretly behind the robbery. Cisco must untangle love, deception, and crime to bring justice.

programme.title: Bad Mans River
programme.desc: Robber Roy King loses his wife, Alicia, to revolutionary Montero. Despite their rivalry they collaborate in an attempt to rob the Mexican government of one million dollars.

programme.title: Djurado
programme.desc: Djurado is a gun-slinging professional gambler who struts into the small town of Silver Mine and wins half of the local saloon, the other part of which belongs to Barbara, whilst battling notorious outlaw Tucan.

programme.title: For a Book of Dollars
programme.desc: A bounty hunter named Amen is hired by a group of nuns to recover stolen money. However, the nuns turn out to be female desperadoes in disguise, plotting to retrieve the booty pillaged by the ruthless outlaw Catapult and his gang. Amen must navigate a world of deception, danger, and betrayal to complete the job.

programme.title: Wyatt Earp S01E01-04
programme.desc: In one of televisions first adult Westerns, the famous marshal puts his life on the line to maintain order, first in Dodge City, Kan., then in Tombstone, Ariz.

programme.title: Day After Tomorrow
programme.desc: Bespectacled bounty hunter Stan Ross arrives in Canyon City after a bank robbery and uncovers a web of corruption. Hired by banker Jefferson to hunt Mexican bandits, Stan learns the bandits were falsely accused and once worked with Jefferson. As Stan digs deeper, he faces betrayal, hidden alliances, and a dangerous grip on the city.

programme.title: Quintana: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: In a Mexican province oppressed by the evil Governor Don Juan de Leyra, the rebel-outlaw Quintana is the sole guardian of justice.

programme.title: Tepepa
programme.desc: In early 20th century Mexico, Tepepa, a revolutionary hero, is set to be executed by Cascorro’s men. Just as the firing squad prepares, Doctor Henry Price, an Englishman, arrives and saves Tepepa. However, Price’s true intentions are revealed when he coldly explains that he saved him only to have the pleasure of killing him himself.

programme.title: The Sundowners
programme.desc: Brother is pitted against brother in this tale of feuding ranchers in the Old West.

programme.desc: A U.S. marshal sets out to bring in a Mexican bandit accused of killing his girlfriends father, but it turns out that theres more to the story than there first appears to be.

programme.desc: In one of televisions first adult Westerns, the famous marshal puts his life on the line to maintain order, first in Dodge City, Kan., then in Tombstone, Ariz.

programme.title: BLITZN

programme.title: Flour Power Holiday Specials
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Twists on the Classics
programme.desc: Christmas is right around the corner and it calls for a little fun - like a twist on traditional holiday desserts! FLOUR POWER CHRISTMAS: TWISTS ON THE CLASSICS offers a new take on some of your favourites to bring you a fresh perspective and world of flavour for the holidays! Enchanting host Jessica McGovern plays off classic desserts, serving up handy hints on how to get the most out of every bite. From sweet and fluffy Gumdrop Cakes drizzled with a light lemony glaze to a delectable Eggnog Ski Slope Cake decorated with rosemary trees and a few friends to hit the hills, Jessicas unique holiday recipes will surly make it on your list of Christmas traditions!

programme.title: Christmas With Bonacini
programme.desc: Christmas with Bonacini is a charming one-hour holiday special featuring celebrity chef Michael Bonacini and his son Oscar. Michael inspires with his favourite Christmas recipes that will add a twinkle of sophistication to your dinner table while lifting holiday spirits.

programme.title: Spencers Holiday BBQ
programme.desc: Join charismatic chef Spencer Watts at his glorious rooftop patio for a one-hour special featuring a full holiday spread, all made on the BBQ. Spencer’s festive menu is all about creative BBQ twists with his delectable, mouth-watering recipes including Burnt Orange Cranberry Marmalade, Maple Rye Pumpkin Pie, and Asparagus with Smoked Salmon Dip. Save room for the piece de Q-sistance: Smoked Turkey Two Ways. This year, take your holiday feast outside and serve up something deliciously different.

programme.title: Flour Power Holiday Specials
programme.desc: The holidays are here! And the holidays come with a lineup of treats you wont be able to resist! From sweet and salty to traditional and unconventional, FLOUR POWER CHRISTMAS: BIG WOW DESSERTS covers it all. To get in the holiday spirit, enchanting host Jessica McGovern introduces two desserts that could impress any Scrooge. First, Jessica bakes a decadent Chocolate Yule Log stuffed with a creamy Salted Caramel Frosting and finishes with a holiday-inspired cake decorated with homemade peppermint candy canes! Interwoven with tricks of the trade, Jessica guides us through her simple yet inspiring treats that are perfect for a big Christmas celebration.

programme.title: One World Kitchen Bakes the Holidays
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 One World Kitchen Bakes the Holidays
programme.desc: Celebrate the holidays with One World Kitchens baked treats from Italy, Japan, Thailand, and Argentina. Our hosts Vanessa, Hana, Pailin, and Natalia put a global twist on classic recipes with Panforte, honey-drizzled Struffoli, Matcha Cheesecake, Thai Shortbread Cookies, Turron, and Pan Dulce. Our warm hosts serve up sweet treats inspired by traditions and family secrets. One World Kitchen: Bakes the Holidays will put you in the festive spirit and bring new holiday traditions to your home!

programme.title: Michael Bonacinis Christmas at the Farm
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Michael Bonacinis Christmas at the Farm
programme.desc: In this heartwarming holiday special, Chef Michael Bonacini invites us to his cozy farmhouse in Ontario for a charming Christmas feast. In this scenic winter retreat, Bonacini interprets classic Welsh and Italian Christmas dishes from his childhood. Michael cooks up comforting dishes from hearty potato leek soup, to succulent roast lamb, to classic molten chocolate lava cake. As he explores homey Christmas flavours, Michael shares his traditions and gives tips for perfecting the holiday meal.

programme.title: Watts Up for the Holidays
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Watts Up for the Holidays
programme.desc: Spencer Watts serves up his take on traditional holiday fare, showing us that you can make an impressive dinner without the stress. In this cheerful one-hour special, charming bachelor Spencer takes you through all the planning tips and lets you in on his secrets to create the ultimate holiday meal.

programme.title: Flour Power Holiday Specials
programme.desc: Christmas is near, and the pressure is on! Between work, home, friends, and family, the list of people to buy for is endless. To help us through this busy time, FLOUR POWER CHRISTMAS: EDIBLE GIFTS offers up four creative and more personal options to make the holidays cheaper, sweeter, and filled with love. programme.desc: Pancho Gomez kidnaps Don Roberto and his daughter, Tonita for ransom. Can an undercover lawman named Gun Smith save the pair, or will he be caught himself?!
