This campy western from 1931 stars Lane Chandler and is sure to keep you enthralled from beginning to end. Directed by Armand Schaefer; starring Marie Quillan and Walter Miller.

programme.title: Tulsa
programme.desc: Susan Hayward stars in this dramatic tale of the Oklahoma oil boom. She plays Cherokee Lansing, a determined young woman out to protect her fathers honor after hes killed by men from a competing oil company. With a cast that includes Robert Preston, Ed Begley, and Pedro Armendariz, this engaging picture from producer Walter Wanger (Cleopatra, I Want to Live!) was nominated for an Academy Award in the Special Effects category. Also, listen for veteran character actor Chill Wills as the narrator!

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Rod Drew (John Wayne) is in search of a missing miner and his daughter in this Lone Star Picture. Along the way, Drew rescues his pal Wabbi (Noah Beery Jr.) from card cheats who have framed him for murder. Youll find plenty of action and suspense in this vintage horse opera, originally distributed by the kings of the B western, Monogram Pictures!

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: The sons of a Colorado cattle baron, one biological and the other adopted, resent one another and fight for control of their fathers cattle empire.

programme.title: High Lonesome
programme.desc: A young drifter is suspected of murder in this stirring production from writer/director Alan Le May (best known for writing The Searchers). John Drew Barrymore stars as Cooncat, a troubled young man who has to steal to survive. With no friends in West Texas, he falls in with some bad customers who involve him in some terrible crimes. The strong cast includes Chill Wills, Jack Elam, and John Archer, with cinematography by Oscar winner W. Howard Greene.

programme.title: Wagon Trail
programme.desc: The son of Sheriff Clay Hartley, of the frontier town Elder, has gotten into bad company and hangs out with an outlaw gang in which, Collins, owner of the Golden Rule Saloon, is the secret head. Sheriff Hartley suspects him, but has been unable to gather the needed evidence. Collins instructs his gang, including young Hartley, to hold up the stagecoach on its return trip from Missionary Flats and take the cargo of gold dust it is carrying. Sheriff Hartley is notified of the planned holdup by one of his deputies who has been spying on Collins, and organizes a posse. A deputy-sheriff is killed in the ensuing gunfight between the lawmen and the outlaws, but Deputy Joe Larkin, pursues and...

Secretly, he signs on as a hired hand at his own ranch to uncover the thief. Once he realizes whats going on, the city boy becomes a hard-riding, avenging son of a six- shooter! Directed by Edward F. Cline from a story by Zane Grey, the film stars George OBrien, Irene Hervey, and LeRoy Mason.

programme.title: Sitting Bull
programme.desc: A cavalry officer sympathetic to the wronged Sioux tribe fixes a meeting between Chief Sitting Bull and President Grant but a dishonest Indian Agent and a hateful General Custer test the Siouxs patience, threatening to derail the peace-talks. Directed and co-written by Sidney Salkow; starring Dale Robertson, Mary Murphy, J. Carrol Naish. Also, look for legendary character actor Iron Eyes Cody as Crazy Horse.

programme.title: Young Bill Hickock

Starring Sally Payne as Calamity Jane, and Rogerss ongoing sidekick George Gabby Hayes, this twofisted saga relives some of Americas most colorful days, and also has time for a few musical numbers, including Up and Down the Prairie, and When the Shadows Fall Across the Rockies.

programme.title: Revenge of the Virgins (Edited Version)

Peter Perry Jr. (The Secret Sex Lives of Romeo and Juliet) directed this early nudie-cutie from a script by legendary cult filmmaker Ed Wood (Plan Nine from Outer Space). Writing under the pen name Peter LaRoche, Wood churned out this screenplay just before he reinvented himself as the author of seedy adult novels.

programme.title: Tumbleweeds
programme.desc: The great William S. Hart stars in this classic tale of settlers in the Oklahoma territory. Directed by King Baggot, one of the most versatile movie figures of the silent era, this movie is not only history recorded in heart throbs, as the original print ads boasted, but shows us why Hart is considered by some to be the top western actor of them all. Hart, who directed many of his own films, also had a hand in directing this feature, which turned out to be his last starring role.

programme.title: Cowboy And The Prizefighter
programme.desc: Red Ryder takes Steve Stevenson, who has saved his life, to his ranch and gives him a job. Reds aunt, the Duchess, knew Steves father, who supposedly committed suicide after losing his ranch betting on a prizefight. Steve refuses to believe that his father took his own life, suspecting he was murdered. Red and Little Beaver aid Steve in finding his father killer.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: Undercover US Marshal John Carruthers (John Wayne) is investigating a rash of robberies by a character known as The Polka Dot Bandit in this B-movie gem. Along the way, Carruthers finds himself in more trouble than hed ever expected! Written and directed by Robert N. Bradbury, the film features George Gabby Hayes, Eleanor Hunt, and many other favorites of the era. Wayne was only 27 at the time of Blue Steel, but was well on his way to becoming The Duke.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: A love story and a search for gold in the Valley of Death! Dubbed simple, powerful and dramatic by the New York Times on the date of its release, Death Valley is indeed an elegant depiction of love and deception in the American desert during the Gold Rush. In what was to be the final film of famed silent film director Paul Powell (Polyanna), a cast of mostly unknown actors produces uniformly excellent work. Lyrical and graceful, Powells film spins the tale of a young boy who finds love and gold, only to have it stolen from him.

programme.title: Outpost In Morocco
programme.desc: George Raft, Mary Windsor, and Akim Tamiroff star in this romantic drama from director Robert Florey (The Florentine Dagger, Daughter of Shanghai). Raft plays Capt. Gerard, a member of the Foreign Legion known for his romantic entanglements. Hes assigned to escort an emirs daughter to her fathers mountain citadel and learn about the emirs activities. Not surprisingly, Gerard finds trouble brewing! With footage shot in Morocco, this movie also features a beautiful musical score by twotime Oscar nominee Michel Michelet (Voice in the Wind).

programme.title: Fallet G
programme.desc: Van Veeterens enda olosta fall kommer upp till ytan igen nar dottern till en privatdetektiv kommer och besoker honom. En våldsam hustrumordare som forsvann under jord for flera år sedan verkar nu ha dykt upp med nytt namn och ar inblandad i ett nytt mord. Van Veeteren har såval professionella som personliga skal att satta fast honom.

programme.title: Alena
programme.desc: Alenas (Amalia Holm) liv ar långt ifrån enkelt och det blir inte battre nar hon borjar på internatskolan Ekensberg, dar hennes liv utvecklas till ett rent helvete. Hon blir direkt trakasserad av de snobbiga tjejerna från lacrosselaget med gangledaren Filippa (Molly Nutley) i spetsen. Alenas basta van, Josefin (Felice Jankell), vagrar dock låta henne ta mer skit och om inte Alena gor något åt saken så kommer Josefin att rycka in, något som kan få odesdigra konsekvenser for alla… Alena ar en ”Låt den ratte komma in” moter ”Fucking Åmål” på Lundsberg.

programme.title: Layers of Lies
programme.desc: Nar han återvander till Iran efter många år i exil i Finland, finner Sam (Ramin Sohrab) att han annu inte har flytt från sitt forflutna. En skum figur kidnappar hans fru Emma (Jessica Wolff) for att dra in honom i ett våldsamt plan for hamnd. Men Sam ar en obeveklig kampmaskin som inte kommer att stoppa någonting for att radda kvinnan han alskar. Nar det galler att bestamma sin framtid kommer det forflutna inte att stå i vagen for dem... Layer of Lies ar en adrenalinfylld spanningstur genom den livliga, mångsidiga metropolen Teheran.

programme.title: Programmet fortsatter strax
programme.desc: Vi tar igen vår skonhetssomn! Stanna kvar for mer prisvard underhållning utvald av Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Odd Man Rush
programme.desc: Odd Man Rush ar baserad på Bill Keenans bastsaljande sjalvbiografi med samma namn. Filmens Bobby Sanders flyttar från Harvards hockeylag till div. 1 i Sverige, i en deal som inbegriper en tvattmaskin och torktumlare. Hans romantisk relation med en tjej i ortens mataffar tvingar honom att se livets realiteter i ogonen och rejalt fundera om barndomsdrommen att spela i NHL ar realistisk.

programme.title: Lognaren
programme.desc: Lognaren ar en beskrivning av en ung skojare som aldrig talar sanning. Den unge mannen spelad av Aki Kaurismaki vandrar genom Helsingfors gator och forsoker låna pengar från bekanta och framlingar med olika forevandningar. Lognaren ar Mika Kaurismakis debutfilm och hans examensarbete från Munchens filmskola.

programme.title: Borkmanns Punkt
programme.desc: Dar ute någonstans gommer sig en mordare som gradvis kanner sig mer och mer saker. Kaalbringen, en liten europeisk kuststad,ar en stad i skrack. Maardam likaså. På kort tid har de två staderna drabbatsav två brutala mord. Nar och var ska ”Halshuggaren” slå till igen?

programme.title: De arvlosa
programme.desc: Mika Kaurismaens forsta långfilm. Han skrev manuset tillsammans med sin bror Aki. "De arvlosa" ar en tidlos skildring av hur småskurken Manne, bonddrangen Harri och den vackra Veera kor en Volga genom de forsvinnande finlandska landskapen, med poliser och gangsters standigt på halarna. Den fartfyllda resan ackompanjeras av tidlosa låtar av bland annat Juice och Rauli Badding.

programme.title: Ljus i skymningen (Lights in the Dusk)
programme.desc: Aki Kaurismakis film om nattvakten Koistinen som forlorar jobbet, friheten och drommarna. Men till sist skonjer han en strimma hopp.

programme.title: Going To Kansas City
programme.desc: Kansas City, here we come” ropar Mikko (Mikko Nousiainen) nar han åker till Kansas City i USA som utbytesstudent. I stallet for storstad hamnar han andå till en småstad som heter Canaan, och dar ar frammande inte alltid valkomna. Mikko faller for vacker Carly Malone, dotter till stans forbittrad assisterande sheriff (Michael Ironside).

programme.title: Klanen - berattelsen om Grudornas slakt
programme.desc: "Klanen" ar historien om en brottslig slakt dar Mika Kaurismaki behandlar existensens villkor genom den traditionella episka formen, på gransen mellan ratt och fel i lagen. Alexander, den yngsta sonen, ar slaktens vita får. Han forvantas hålla sig på den raka vagen, till skillnad från sin far och andra man i slakten. Men familjen ar varst, och blod ar tjockare an vatten... Familjedramat "Klanen" ar en storslagen hyllning till den gamla finska filmen.

programme.title: Svalan, Katten, Rosen, Doden
programme.desc: Munster upptacker kroppen av en ung strypt kvinna i hennes hem och overraskar mordaren som fortfarande finns i lokalen. Mordaren hinner fly men lamnar efter sig en sallsynt bok på platsen. Boken innehåller en halsning från den skyldige. Nar ett offer till hittas satts Van Veeterens litterara kunskaper på prov for att hinna stoppa seriemordaren innan fler mord begås.

programme.title: Carambole
programme.desc: En man kor på en 14-årig pojke som dor ogonblickligen. Det ar morkt och regnigt och han smiter från olycksplatsen. Ett misstag som han bittert får ångra och som forandrar hela hans liv. For Van Veeteren blir det ett fall som drabbar honom personligen, ett fall som kostar honom en av sina karaste...

programme.title: Total Balalaika Show
programme.desc: Total Balalaika Show ar en dokumentar om en otrolig handelse, ett fantastiskt mote mellan ost och vast. I juni 1993 genomfordes en historisk konsert i Helsingfors. Rockgruppen Leningrad Cowboys spelade tillsammans med Alexandrov Ensemblen (Roda Armen) , en kor med 100 sångare, ca 40 musiker och 20 dansare. Tillsammans framforde de bland annat ”Happy Together”, ”Delilah”, ”Gimme All Your Lovin’” och ”Knocking On Heaven’s Door”. Aki Kaurismaki ar kand for sina socialrealistiska skildringar och svarta karleksforklaringar till ett dystert Finland. Filmer med komiska och omsinta inslag.

programme.title: Flickan från tandsticksfabriken
programme.desc: Iris ar trott på sitt dodstråkiga jobb och liv. For att pigga upp stamningen beger hon sig ut på stan och shoppar en rod klanning. Natten spenderar hon med en rik man som lamnar henne en summa pengar morgonen efter. En tid senare upptacker Iris att hon ar gravid och upplyser den formogne mannen om sin situation, han skickar en ny bunt sedlar och ber henne att gora abort. Då går Iris ut och koper en stor mangd råttgift.

programme.title: Moreno and tystnaden
programme.desc: En flicka mordas strax efter att hon har lamnat en sluten religios grupp och det blir en svår utredning for Moreno eftersom ingen i den religiosa gruppen ar villig att samarbeta. Men nar ytterligare en flicka kidnappas och hennes blodiga naglar skickas till polisen, borjar folk att prata. Ska tiden racka till for Moreno att losa fallet och hitta flickan, eller ar det redan for sent?

programme.title: The Last Border
programme.desc: På en genomgripande fororenad planet återstår endast några få beboeliga zoner. Vid polcirkeln finns en ren region, vars invånare kampar for overlevnad mot en militarjunta och laglosa gerillagang. Livet har forvandlats till en kamp, och faror lurar overallt. Men den farligaste av mannen ar den som redan har forlorat allt.

programme.title: Papperstjarnan
programme.desc: "Pappersstjarnan" ar baserad på verkliga handelser. Det handlar om en fotomodell, hennes tre man, ett dekadent liv, utnyttjande och offentlig kritik. Anna (Pirkko Hamalainen) ar en fore detta miss, nu en toppmodell, vars liv spårar ur på grund av mannen. Anna blir så småningom foremål for utnyttjande av både den skumma affarsmannen Ulf (Hannu Lauri) och den alkoholiserade och våldsamma fotografen Ilja (Kari Vaananen). Den enda riktiga vannen visar sig vara Taukka (Matti Rasila), som har en modig installning till livet. Anna beslutar sig for att forsoka fly från de svåra delarna av sitt liv, men det kraver modiga beslut och beredskap att betala deras pris.

programme.title: Ariel
programme.desc: Taisto jobbar i en gruva i norra Finland. Nar gruvan stangs reser han mot Helsingfors i en vrakig cabriolet som han ovantat får. Men problemen tornar upp sig. Han blir rånad, hittar inget jobb och doms till fangelse for misshandel. Men med hjalp av sin flickvan Irmeli, en ensamstående mor han traffar i Helsingfors och sin cellkamrat planerar Taisto att bryta sig ur fangelset och starta om på nytt. Aki Kaurismaki ar kand for sina socialrealistiska skildringar och svarta karleksforklaringar till ett dystert Finland. Filmer med komiska och omsinta inslag.

programme.title: Programmet fortsatter strax
programme.desc: Vi tar igen vår skonhetssomn! Stanna kvar for mer prisvard underhållning utvald av Rakuten TV.

programme.title: En tomtesaga
programme.desc: I Lappland for hundra år sedan forlorade lille Nikolas sin familj i en olycka. Byns invånare tog gemensamt hand om pojken. Varje jul flyttade han till en ny familj och for att visa sin tacksamhet gav Nikolas en gång per år presenter till familjernas barn. Men nar Nikolas fyllde 13 år tvingades han borja jobba hos Isak, en bitter snickare som forbjod honom att gora presenter...

programme.title: Ljus i skymningen (Lights in the Dusk)
programme.desc: Aki Kaurismakis film om nattvakten Koistinen som forlorar jobbet, friheten och drommarna. Men till sist skonjer han en strimma hopp.

programme.title: Skuggor i paradiset
programme.desc: Nikander ar en ensam sopbils-chauffor som en dag moter den anspråkslosa snabbkopskassorskan Ilona. Nikander blir blixtrande kar, men deras omsesidiga blyghet medfor att det romantiska lyser med sin frånvaro. Så plotsligt andras livet… Ilona får sparken och de bestammer sig for att traffas på ett mysigt litet motell. Aki Kaurismaki ar kand for sina socialrealistiska skildringar och svarta karleksforklaringar till ett dystert Finland. Filmer med komiska och omsinta inslag.

programme.title: Odd Man Rush
programme.desc: Odd Man Rush ar baserad på Bill Keenans bastsaljande sjalvbiografi med samma namn. Filmens Bobby Sanders flyttar från Harvards hockeylag till div. 1 i Sverige, i en deal som inbegriper en tvattmaskin och torktumlare. Hans romantisk relation med en tjej i ortens mataffar tvingar honom att se livets realiteter i ogonen och rejalt fundera om barndomsdrommen att spela i NHL ar realistisk.

programme.title: Carambole
programme.desc: En man kor på en 14-årig pojke som dor ogonblickligen. Det ar morkt och regnigt och han smiter från olycksplatsen. Ett misstag som han bittert får ångra och som forandrar hela hans liv. For Van Veeteren blir det ett fall som drabbar honom personligen, ett fall som kostar honom en av sina karaste...

programme.title: Moln på drift
programme.desc: Ilona och Lauri ar ett stravsamt par som inte begar mycket av livet. Tak over huvudet, mat på bordet, ett glas vin och en kvall framfor tv-n. De arbetar plikttroget och agnar sina korta ledigheter åt varandra och sin hund. Men en dag hander något som hotar att slå deras trygga tillvaro i spillror. En varm och absurd historia om ett alldeles vanligt par någonstans i Finland.

programme.title: Amazon
programme.desc: Den finske mannen Kari (Kari Vaananen) bestemmer seg for å flytte til Brasil med sine to døtre etter kona hans dør. Snart møter han den eventyrlystne amerikanske flygeren Dan (Robert Davi: Die Hard), som forteller Kari om planen sin om å grave etter gull i Amazonas-jungelen. Men Kari møter også den vakre Paola (Rae Dawn Chong: Commando), som lærer ham mer om situasjonen i Amazonas og truslene mot den.

programme.title: Vinski och osynlighetspulvret
programme.desc: Vinski och osynlighetspulvret utspelas i den fiktiva staden Hompstad, som skakas av en brottsvåg. Inbrott och rån har blivit en del av stadsbornas vardag och det behovs en riktig superhjalte for att hjalpa polisen. Skolpojken Vinski (Kuura Rossi) lar kanna den mystiske apotekaren (Martti Suosalo), som erbjuder Vinski mojligheten att bli Hompstads hjalte. Apotekarens hemlighet ar ett pulver, som gor personen osynlig och ger mojlighet att gå genom vaggar. Med hjalp av osynlighetspulvret skulle Vinski kunna avsloja en hemlig rånarliga och dess ledare, med endast ett par gula handskar som ledtråd.

programme.title: De arvlosa
programme.desc: Mika Kaurismaens forsta långfilm. Han skrev manuset tillsammans med sin bror Aki. "De arvlosa" ar en tidlos skildring av hur småskurken Manne, bonddrangen Harri och den vackra Veera kor en Volga genom de forsvinnande finlandska landskapen, med poliser och gangsters standigt på halarna. Den fartfyllda resan ackompanjeras av tidlosa låtar av bland annat Juice och Rauli Badding.

Lognaren ar Mika Kaurismakis debutfilm och hans examensarbete från Munchens filmskola.

programme.title: Hamlet i affarsvarlden
programme.desc: Efter sin faders dod arver Hamlet en styrelseplats i ett gummiforetag. Hamlets farbror kontrollerar foretaget och bestammer sig for att de ska satsa på en ny marknad, namligen gummiankor. Men den nyblivne styrelsemedlemmen ar misstanksam, framforallt over omstandigheterna kring faderns dod. Aki Kaurismaki regisserar har en smått bisarr ”film-noir” variant av Shakespeares HAMLET. Aki Kaurismaki ar kand for sina socialrealistiska skildringar och svarta karleksforklaringar till ett dystert Finland. Filmer med komiska och omsinta inslag.

programme.title: Bieffekterna
programme.desc: Forskarstudenten Julia och programmeraren Rebecca ingår i ett elitteam vid Lunds universitet. De jobbar med den kontroversiella vetenskapliga metoden biohacking, genteknikens nya hopp som kan betyda slutet for dodliga sjukdomar i vår livstid.

programme.title: 30:e november
programme.desc: Adam och hans polare spenderar sin tid med att trakassera invandrare som de hatar. Men så moter Adam Julia från Peru och de blir blixtforalskad, eftersom varken Adams vanner eller Julias familj skulle acceptera att de två ar tillsammans tvingas de hålla sin karlek hemlig. På Sveriges nationaldag drabbas Adam och hans gang samman med Julias bror, Sascha, och hans vanner. Det hela slutar med att två dodads.

programme.title: Layers of Lies
programme.desc: Nar han återvander till Iran efter många år i exil i Finland, finner Sam (Ramin Sohrab) att han annu inte har flytt från sitt forflutna. En skum figur kidnappar hans fru Emma (Jessica Wolff) for att dra in honom i ett våldsamt plan for hamnd. Men Sam ar en obeveklig kampmaskin som inte kommer att stoppa någonting for att radda kvinnan han alskar. Nar det galler att bestamma sin framtid kommer det forflutna inte att stå i vagen for dem... Layer of Lies ar en adrenalinfylld spanningstur genom den livliga, mångsidiga metropolen Teheran.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Nar Joel (Paul Rudd) och Molly (Amy Poehler) mottes var det hat vid forsta ogonkastet: hans storbolag Godiskompaniet hotade att stanga ner hennes bohemiska godisaffar. Plus att Joel fortfarande hade kanslor for sitt sexiga ex (Cobie Smulders). Men, trots allt så blir de kara, tills dess att de gor slut och Molly borjar dejta sin revisor (Ed Helms). Men, precis i sluttampen...tja, du får se helt enkelt. (Ledtråd: Joel håller ett stort tal och de hittar tillbaka till varandra.) Från regissoren som skapade Wet Hot American Summer, Wanderlust och Role Models kommer nu en helknapp och satirisk underminering av den romantiska komedigenren.

programme.title: 9 1/2 vecka (9½ Weeks)

Hon vet nastan inget om mannens liv, det enda hon ser ar deras sexlekar och deras relation blir alltmer komplicerad. Erotisk kultfilm med Oscarsvinnaren Kim Basinger och Oscarsnominerade Mickey Rourke

programme.title: Programmet fortsatter strax

programme.title: Loves Last Resort
programme.desc: Efter att ha dejtat i tio år har Chloes pojkvan Eric annu ite mognat till den man hon onskar han skulle vara. Hon hoppas skynda på forloppet genom att dumpa honom. Sex månader senare traffas de och Eric avslojar nyheten om att han ska gifta sig. For att komma bort tar hon semester och på samma semesterort dyker Eric med flickvan upp.

programme.title: Never Too Late
programme.desc: Fyra veteraner som overlevt Vietnamkrigets fånglager bestammer sig for att genomfora en sista flykt – från aldreboendet. Men att planera en rymning i ett senilt gang bjuder på utmaningar. Var och en bar på drommar, for vilka de ar beredda att satsa allt på detta sista hjaltedåd – om de bara kunde komma ihåg vad de skulle gora.

programme.title: My Super Ex

Matt (Luke Wilson) tror sig ha funnit den ratta nar han traffar Jenny (Uma Thurman) som ar både sexig och smart... Men nar Matt bestammer sig for att gora slut, blir det något han snart kommer att ångra...

programme.title: Sander jul

programme.title: Griffin and Phoenix
programme.desc: Nar Griffin har fått diagnosen att han har dodlig cancer bestammer han sig for att ta livet i egna hander och ha lite kul innan han dor. Samtidigt som tiden for hans liv rinner ut traffar han och blir kar i Phoenix - som också har en hemlighet.

programme.title: Bottled with Love
programme.desc: Abbey ar mitt i karriaren, olycklig, frustrerad och hopplost uppgiven efter alla misslyckade dater. Hennes mormor foreslår att hon skriver ner alla hennes onskningar som ett karleksbrev rakt från hjartat. Motvilligt foljer hon rådet och stoppar ner brevet i en flaska och slanger ut den i hamnen. Tiden går och månader senare hamnar Abbey i ett projekt med hennes chefs son Nick. Han ska aven av en handelse hittat flaskan med Abbeys brev, helt ovetande om att det ar hon som skrivit. Sakta borjar Nick forstå kopplingen och får det valdigt jobbigt med situationen och hemligheten. Han beslutar att beratta om det funna brevet. Abbey ber honom dra åt helvete som fort henne bakom ljuset.

programme.title: Who Gets The Dog
programme.desc: Nar Olive (Alicia Silverstone) och Clay (Ryan Kwanten) traffades var det karlek vid forsta ogonkastet. De gifte sig, kopte ett hus och adopterade en nyfodd valp - Wesley. Nu har det gått sex år och de har bestamt sig for att skiljas och båda vill ta med sig sin alskade Wesley. Utan vilja till kompromiss går frågan till domstol och en lång vårdnadsstrid vantar nar domaren begar en 60 dagar lång bedomning av dem båda for att se vem som ar den basta foraldern och de ar båda två fast beslutna att vinna – till varje pris.

programme.title: Karlekens sloja (The Painted Veil)
programme.desc: Kitty ar en rastlos ung kvinna från overklassen som vill bort från sin familj. Nar hon traffar lakaren Walter Fane ser hon sin chans och gifter sig med honom. Tillsammans flyttar de till Shanghai dar Kitty blir foralskad i en annan man.

programme.title: Min sommarprins
programme.desc: PR-krischefen Deidre och hennes assistent Mandy flyger in nar den upproriske prinsen Colin grips i småstaden Idaho. Men nar Deidre moter ett eget fiasko, får Mandy ovantade karriar- (och romantiska) mojligheter.

programme.title: Date and Switch
programme.desc: Sistaårseleverna Michael och Matty har varit basta kompisar sen lågstadiet. Då de fortfarande ar oskulder sluter de en pakt att hjalpa varandra att få i sang någon innan studentbalen, men deras planer andras drastiskt nar Matt berattar att han ar homosexuell.

programme.title: Love Hurts

programme.title: Below Her Mouth
programme.desc: "allas (Erika Linder) ar trott på sin tillvaro – hon sliter som taklaggare på dagen och traffar alskarinnor på natten – samma sak varje dag. Tills hon traffar den sjalvsakra och framgångsrika moderedaktoren Jasmine på en klubb. Från forsta ogonkastet dras de som magneter till varandra, och kastar sig rakt in i en passionerad affar. Jasmine ser rakt igenom Dallas installsamma charm och Dallas ser Jasmines langtan efter att få vara sig sjalv. Det finns bara ett litet problem, Jasmines fastmans Rile. Below Her Mouth ar ett vågat och hett drama med ett helkvinnligt filmteam, från regissor till filmfotograf och skripta.

programme.title: In Tranzit
programme.desc: Baserad på en sann historia. I chockvågorna efter andra varldskriget, under den kalla vintern 1946, skickas av misstag en grupp tyska krigsfångar till ett ryskt kvinnofånglager som styrs av kvinnliga fångvaktare. Fångvaktarna, som forlorat många narstående på grund av Nazisternas brutalitet, mottar de nyanlanda fångarna med stor fientlighet och ser en mojlighet till hamnd...

programme.title: You Will Meet a Tall Dark Stranger
programme.desc: I denna stormiga komedi av Woody Allen, upptacker två par att graset inte alltid ar gronare på andra sidan. Alfie Shepridge (ANTHONY HOPKINS) dumpar sin fru sedan 40 år (GEMMA JONES), i ett forsok att återuppleva ungdomens nojen tillsammans med en ung callgirl (LUCY PUNCH). For att få ratsida på sitt liv tar den forsmådda hustrun hjalp av en spådam. Samtidigt blir deras dotter Sally (NAOMI WATTS) foralskad i sin chef (ANTONIO BANDERAS), och hennes make (JOSH BROLIN) blir besatt av skonheten som bor på andra sidan gatan (FREIDA PINTO). programme.title: The Right Kind of Wrong
programme.desc: Leo Palamino ar den misslyckade forfattaren som blev diskare som blev beromd for alla sina fel och brister genom bloggen “Varfor du suger”, den enorma natsuccen som skrivs av hans exfru. programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E08 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 8, Finland - U105 (Part 1)
programme.desc: The World championship in lightweights of the Strongman Champions League bring to us 50 strongmen from all over the world. All athletes are under 105 kilograms and for them this is the step up to the ultimate heavyweights.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E09 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 9, Finland - U105 (Part 2)
programme.desc: In this second stage of the World championship of lightweights we will find out who out of the 12 athletes will win the title in the under 105 kilogram category.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E10 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 10, Romania (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first part of SCL Romania 2018 will be hosted in Brasov. This episode features a new event for Strongman Champion League: “ The Chopper Pull”!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E11 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 11, Romania (Part 2)
programme.desc: After three classical Strongman events – Dead lift, Loading and Front hold – and one historical, Chopper Pull for the first time in history of Strongman, now we go to find out who will take title in Romania. This is the second stage in Romania and it remains to be seen who will win the title; Aivars, Travis or Krzyzstof?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E12 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 12, Curacao (Part 1)
programme.desc: The next destination of Strongman Champions League is in a piece of paradise on earth – Curacao. We bring to you some special Strongman events like the Rock Lift, Tug of War and Weight for Height in this episode.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E13 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 13, Curacao (Part 2)
programme.desc: This is the last competition before the grand finals. After the first three events Zageris is in top place, but can O’Hagan, Baggott, Petursson and Ortmayer step into the final? Last chance some of them will find through events like Forward Hold, Truck Pull, Dead Lift and loading very big objects.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E14 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 14, Road to Mexico
programme.desc: We bring you 50 minutes of Strongman inside. Fears, inspiration, courage, the best and worst from our finalists and their expectation of the finals. We also go to Poland and Germany to represent one day in the training of Krzysztof Radzikowski and Dennis Kohlruss. See all the finalists for Mexico in their comfort zone here, with their backgrounds /motivations /family and friends.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E15 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 15, Mexico - World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing their boundaries and testing their limits to take the World title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E16 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 16, Mexico - World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: After 11 months and 14 competitions all over the world, it all comes down to the final in this episode. The strongmen must show their best skills and every mistake is expensive, so their concentration must be at the highest possible level. Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E01 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 1, World Strongest Viking
programme.desc: This year 14 athletes from all over the world came to Fefor to compete in 6 cruel events. Well see typical Viking disciplines on very heavy conditions in land of snow and ice, World records and athletes like the title defender Krzysztof Radzikowski, strongest guys from Holland and Germany and many more

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E02 SCL S6 Ep2 FIBO Power
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capita in the World and of course, the most powerful host in Strongman champions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2019 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E03 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 3, Turkey
programme.desc: On a spectacular beach in Alanya, the MLO Strongman Champions League Turkey was viewed by thousands of spectators over a two day battle. With 12 athletes at the start over 6 cruel events, like Marble Stone Lift, Truckpull and Deadlift cars. And with the comeback of Travis Ortmayer / USA, former stone king and world ranked competitor. Winner of several SCL stages in the past.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E04 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 4, Holland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Four times Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter competing here in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, and 3 in this episode: The first event, a truckpull of 17.000 kg over 25 meters in max 75 seconds, was a real hard pull Also for the World Champion Truckpull, Holland’s runner-up Kelvin de Ruiter, but watch his amazing technique here.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E05 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 5, Holland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter, competing in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, 3 in this second episode; a Viking-press of 150 kg with the current world record holder Luke Herrick. The fifth event, a front hold of 25 kg is loved or hated by the athletes and lastly, the Stones of Strength.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E06 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 6, Russia
programme.desc: An unbelievable TANK PULL of 50.000 kg was at the stage of SCL RUSSIA. Never seen this before! Not only a tank pull was done here but also the Viking Press/ Deadlift Max and Log lift reps were spectacular events to see here in Russia. With Mikhail Koklyaev also as event presenter, the former top 3 world strongest man from Russia was there

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E07 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 7, Serbia
programme.desc: In this year’s edition on The Balkan Peninsula, we have competing the new talent from Estonia Marko Remlik together with Sebastian Kurek from Poland and yellow leader Kelvin de Ruiter

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E08 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 8, Finland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland and Aivars Smaukstelis from Latvia are the strongman future of these days. Mateusz is the best man in the World at the moment to defeat. Only 25 years and such a fantastic strongman. They come here only for a win. But there are 12 more Strong athletes in this episode who want the title of Finland as well.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E09 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 9, Finland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Mateusz Is leading after day 1 (previous episode) with close behind him Aivars Smaukstelis and Zake Muluzi from the UK. All very exciting! 5 events in this episode: Log Lift, Fram Walk, Deadlift, Sack Throw (Weight for Height), Loading medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E10 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 10, Portugal
programme.desc: In this stage we have a new strong debutant: Oleg Sylka from the Ukraine. He is the new talent, who will stand up against the old champions like ZSydrunas Savickas and Brian Shaw and the Stoltman Brother from the UK. This new talent Oleg is a great character and we will see him flame in the episode in Portugal.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E11 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 11, Callio
programme.desc: In Callio is the deepest mine of Europe/ 1500 meter deep, whereas the MLO Strongman Champions League also did 1 event. The Forward Hold, on a 1500 dept/ also a kind of new record/ as it was never done before. Spectacular and new in Strongman sport.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E12 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 12, Ukraine
programme.desc: Kelvin de Ruiter is here to defend his SCL World Truck Pull Championships title. But this year, another strong field wants his title. Over 3 different pulls with 3 different trucks, and 14 athletes at the start, it will be difficult for everybody.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E13 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 13, Caribbean
programme.desc: SCL edition Curacao 2019 was a great event, twelve power boys from all over made a great show at the white beaches, and 35 degrees Celsius heat in the Carrabean Islands. Two events were held on Friday at the beach of beautiful resort Sunscape, the other three were held near the world famous floating bridge at Willemstad on Saturday night.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E14 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 14, Dubai
programme.desc: Hosted at Meydan Grandstand in Dubai, the Strongman Champions League had some really big names in the list like Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland, Brian Shaw from the USA and Krzysztof Radzikowski. In front of the Burj Khalifa the athletes do the deadlift max and 4 other heavy events at another spot in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E15 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 15, World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. The last stage over 2 episodes of the MLO Strongman Champions League, were held in Porto, Portugal. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E16 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 16, World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results and this is the final!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E01 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 1, Norway
programme.desc: The spectacular Fefor Arena hosted for the 8th time the Worlds Strongest Viking, part of the SCL World Series. But with the absence of former title holders its anyones game. Again, a very spectacular episode of the Strongman Champions League here in Norway.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E02 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 2, Finland (Part 1)
programme.desc: In this episode, the Titan, former double World champion from Latvia will compete against his fellow countryman and the current World champion - Aivars Smaukstelis. With 8 events over 2 stages the contestants are pushed to their limits in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E03 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 3, Finland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Dainis Zageris and Aivars Smaukstelis, both from Latvia have a serious, strong battle in the this second and final episode of the SCL Finland 2020. Watch the unbelievable and brute power of these athletes in the last 4 events to crown the winner.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E04 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 4, World Record Breakers
programme.desc: The SCL Germany event takes place in an ancient castle called Die Burg in the heart of Germany. Its here where 5 world record attempts take place across 5 different events with 10 athletes. They will go to the max! See this and much more in the SCL Germany 2020.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E05 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 5, Strongest Viking
programme.desc: SCL Norway is normally all about snow, wind, and cold weather. Our brave athletes are used to compete under conditions few other athletes have competed in, but after COVID delays the competition has been moved from winter to summer bringing in a whole new range of challenges. With an impressive athlete list who will be the winner across 5 cruel events?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E06 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 6, World Strongest Team 1
programme.desc: Were in sunny Finland for the next stage of a double-bill of SCL action, but this time its a team event. A truly fantastic event with 6000 spectators. Even during COVID times this was exceptional! 8 Strong Teams where fighting for the title over a crazy 9 events.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E07 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 7, World Strongest Team 2
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland, done over 9 cruel events. In this episode the last and final 5 events take place. 8 Strong Teams are fighting for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E08 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 8, Portugal
programme.desc: The next set of challenges are set in sunny Esposende in Portugal. With stars such as Travis Ortmayer, Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland, and Ervin Toots from Estonia. While Fabio Silva will defend the honour in his own country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E09 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 9, World Records (Part 1)
programme.desc: We are back in Germany, with the world record breakers. We promise you this is going to be amazing. Do not move from that seat, because we are going to see some records smashed today. Over 6 cruel events, you will see who gets crowned of the King Of The Castle!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E10 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 10, World Records (Part 2)
programme.desc: With the next episode of Strongman Champions League Germany. Its the world record breakers, and in the last show we set two new records. Can more be records be broken before the king of the castle is crowned?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E11 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 11, Worlds 105 Kg (Part 1)
programme.desc: Welcome to Kokkola in Finland. This city will be the setting for the Lightweight World championship. Out of 24 athletes, only 16 will make it through to the final day, but who will champion each event and who is going to be eliminated?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E12 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 12, Worlds 105 Kg (Part 2)
programme.desc: Its the second day, and the top 16 athletes have made it through to the final round. With another 4 events to go who will get the crown of world champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E13 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 13, Ukraine
programme.desc: Welcome to Ukraine and the wonderful capital city of Kyiv. Were here for the second time for the iconic truck pull World Championships! The reigning World champion Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland will defend his title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E14 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 14, Romania
programme.desc: In this episode, a final chance for our athletes to get vital world series ranking points on board to give them the best possible chance of success and an initial advantage at the finals. Its the last show before the world finals and the top 10 places are up for grabs, but who will they be?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E15 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 15, World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E16 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 16, World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E01 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 1, Finland Stage 1
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E02 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 2, Holland Part 1
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E03 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 3, Holland Part 2
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E04 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 4, Serbia Part 1
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E05 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 5, Serbia Part 2
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E06 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 6, Joensuu Part 1
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E07 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 7, Joensuu Part 2
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E08 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 8, Esposende
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E09 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 9, Great Britain
programme.desc: Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn’t been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E10 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 10, Poland Part 1
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland the home of Legends Mariusz Pudzianowkski and Krzystof Radzikowski. Who will grab the title here in holiday resort Sopot, on the great Balrtic Sea with 6 events and 12 athlets in the mix!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E11 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 11, Poland Part 2
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E12 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 12, Bosnia
programme.desc: it’s been a long time since the world series held a championship here in Sarajevo. Let’s see what test of strength this destination holds for our athletes. And what fantastic athletes are here again in Stage 12 of the SCL World Series. The strongman champions league Bosnia is another iconic Strongman event with the return of Rongo Keen from Australia and Portugal winner 2022 George Sulaiman.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E13 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 13, Romania
programme.desc: Welcome to Sibiu in Romania. It’s an important day for some of these athletes, because four of them have a real chance of getting into our all-exclusive world finals. There’s only one more stage after this to get those all-important extra points. So, there’s going to be some fireworks, who will take the title here and who will qualify for the World Finals?

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: Downsizing can be a difficult transition and Jins objective is to make it as seamless as possible. In this episode, Jin is getting outdoors by practicing archery with Mike but mostly just to compete for bragging rights. Jins client is moving from a house in Port Credit to a luxurious condo close to the downtown core. They desire extra bedrooms for when their children are visiting, all the amenities, and waterfront views.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: Mikes couple is looking for their luxurious dream home anywhere in between Toronto and Barrie near HWY 400 in a prestigious neighborhood. They have a large dog, tall family, and want to start a family of their own. This means they are going to need a lot of space and want the house to be fully renovated or brand-new. Mike is the perfect agent for this couple because he lives, eats, and breathes the luxury lifestyle.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: An amazing beachfront property is what Inezs couple is looking for and these top million dollar agents are sure to surpass their expectations. Inezs client currently lives in a condo and have one child, however, they desire a home that they can comfortably expand their family in.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: Mikes friend invites him to an Indian wedding and tells him about his uncle who is looking for a luxury condo close to the airport. Daryl, Inez, and Jin support and donate to Mikes charity after winning a bet amongst them and the amount is determined by how long Mike lasts in the ring boxing against a professional. This client is looking for an investment property and a place for him to live when visiting.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: A young trendy couple wants to start a family in Toronto but they need some help from these top million dollar agents. Jin is a natural daredevil and has always wanted to skydive with her clients. In Oakville, Jin practices at iFly that is an indoor skydiving facility. Jins client lives a very active and busy lifestyle so they require somewhere with low maintenance but still has enough space for a big family. Inez takes Jin to her hair stylist Anastasia for some business and pleasure.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: Moving in together can be stressful but fun because you are starting a new life together! Inezs client is selling their separate properties and looking for a house or condo in the city or beach area that is close to shopping, groceries, schools, etc. Inezs couple is not too picky and open to different kinds of properties. Daryl and Inez enjoy a beautiful bike ride along the beaches boardwalk to discuss her client and the perfect luxury listing he has found.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: Agreeing on a vacation home is made much harder when these top million dollar agents have astounding listings. Mikes client is looking for a waterfront cottage with lots of land and privacy. What better way to check out some waterfront listings then from a helicopter? Debbie wants a family cottage that feels homey, however, Paul wants an impressive high-end cottage that he can bring his business clients to.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: Remarrying is hard enough let alone combining two families under one roof. With a total of 4 children between the ages of 7 and 16 Jins client is definitely going to need lots of space and land in a safe neighborhood. Daryl, Inez, and Mike attend Jins band practice to support her and listen to the set list they have prepared for an upcoming charity event. Jin gets her nails done frequently and this time Daryl decides to join her for some much needed pampering.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: Many people enjoy staying busy and always having a project on the go. Inezs client loves to build and create breathtaking properties. On their next project, this couple wants an interesting property, preferably waterfront, which they can use for an investment property or to build on. Inez takes her client on a private yacht so they can cruise around Lake Ontario and discuss the clients wish list.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: Deborah and Vezi are an international couple that want to live in Toronto for one year but has no idea where to start looking. Luckily for them Mike, Jin, Daryl, and Inez have teamed up to find them the home of their dreams. They agree to split the commission and throw a yacht party for the clients decision. Mike arranges a private plane for all four agents to go to Montreal and discuss in style what the client is looking for.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S02 : E01 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: The King is back, baby! Daryl King is known to make an entrance, and he wants the houses he shows to have that same "wow" factor. His clients are looking for a grand mansion, and with their sizeable budget wont settle for anything less than spectacular.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S02 : E02 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: Will Daryl be able to dazzle his clients and find a property that will take their breath away? This episode features the first two of four properties, with a special guest appearance by Design Generation builder and designer Carlo Rinomato.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S02 : E04 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: With the help of a Bangkok real estate expert, Max Gloeckner, Mike is confident he can deliver just what Mae is looking for. This episode features the last two of four properties, as well as the reveal of which house the client decides to purchase.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S02 : E05 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: Vicky is searching for a home in The Beaches for her and her family. No one knows the Beach like Inez Kudryk, so Vicky enlists her help in finding some stunning luxury properties to tour. With a grand budget and very particular tastes, Inez knows that Vicky will be a tough client to please.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S02 : E06 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: Will Vicky find the forever home of her dreams? This episode features the last two of four properties, as well as the reveal of which house the clients decide to purchase and special appearances by guest agent Jasmine Xuereb and mortgage broker Paul Meredith.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S02 : E08 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: Unfortunately for Rosa, she isnt seeing the benefits of moving to a town around Cambridge. Steves got some neat ideas, but will they be able to convince Rosa? This episode features the last two of four properties, as well as the reveal of which house the clients decide to purchase.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S02 : E09 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: Sofie Kehdi heads to the island of Ambergris Caye, Belize to help a friend and former client, actress and choreographer Zuzana Marosová. As a public figure, Zuzana craves privacy in her personal time and is looking for a relaxing space to unwind with her children.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S02 : E10 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: With the help of local realtor Daniel Hartin, Sofie sets her sights on the perfect home...and hopefully a bit of fun in the sun! This episode features the last two of four properties, as well as the reveal of which house the client decides to purchase.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S02 : E11 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: Jessica and Mark are a young couple living and working in Thailand after meeting there several years ago and falling in love. They are looking for a permanent home in Bangkok, and after chatting with her friend Mae, Jessica knows that Mike Donia is the man for the job.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S02 : E13 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: After helping them find a home last season, Inez is enlisted by Martin and Cheryl to help them find the perfect investment property. While Cheryl wants a property with minimal work and no landlord responsibilities, Martin is more open to renovations and taking on some of the commonplace duties associated with property management.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S02 : E14 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: This episode features the last two of four properties, as well as the reveal of which house the clients decide to purchase, with special guest appearances by interior design expert Shelley Alexanian and guest agent Mo Loulou.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S02 : E15 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: This weeks episode features Cambridge realtor extraordinaire Steve Bailey as he helps couple Dan and Melinda search for the perfect home. Its a real battle of contemporary vs. traditional as Dan and Melinda hash it out over where their future lies. Melinda surprises Dan with some new information, but can Steve surprise them both by showing them the perfect property?

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S02 : E17 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: Vancouver-based couple Jim and Shannon are looking to relocate to their hometown of Toronto with their two daughters. With a budget of 10 million dollars, they enlist the help of savvy realtor Sofie Kehdi. While it might first seem that Jim and Shannon are on the same page, the house hunt proves that they have some differing opinions on what makes a good investment.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S02 : E18 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: This episode features the last two of four properties, as well as the reveal of which house the clients decide to purchase, with a special appearance by guest agent Tyrone N. Steer.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent

programme.desc: Vezi and Deborah love the house they purchased last season in Stouffville, but they are ready to make the move to the big city. programme.desc: Suhail and Niki have busy schedules. Hes a marketing director and shes a doctor so shes often on call for a hospital downtown. Can they find a place that can help relieve stress, but also be close enough to downtown for those urgent calls? They want a secluded home with at least 1 acre and magnificent views.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S04 : E03 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: Wendy and Daniel are looking to downsize after their kids have moved out, but still want an elegant home. Shes a physical therapist and shes a business analyst. They want something that can help them relax at the end of the day, with at least 4 bedrooms and away from the downtown core. Can Lou find them something that fits?

programme.title: Don Jon
programme.desc: Don Martell ar en kille från New Jersey, vars liv kretsar kring familjen, vannerna, kyrkan – och porr. Formågan att ragga upp nya tjejer varje helg har gett honom smeknamnet ”Don Jon”. En kvall traffar han den snygga och romantiska Barbara som letar efter en underbar dromkille, en idealbild som ar valdigt långt från Don.

programme.title: Criminal Activities
programme.desc: Fyra vanner snubblar over en affarsmojlighet som ar for bra for att tacka nej till. Nar investeringen går snett uppdagas det att en del av de satsade pengarna kom från en hansynslos maffiaboss…och nu ar det dags att betala tillbaka. For att bli kvitt sina skulder får de fyra i uppdrag att kidnappa en familjemedlem i en rivaliserande maffiafamilj. Om uppdraget lyckas har de en chans att undkomma med liven i behåll. John Travolta (”Pulp Fiction”), Michael Pitt (“Boardwalk Empire”) och Dan Stevens (“Downton Abbey”) spelar rollerna i denna actionspackade thriller om insiderhandel, maffian och en obeveklig stravan efter hamnd.

programme.title: Awake
programme.desc: En man vaknar på sjukhuset utan att minnas vem han ar och hur han har hamnat dar. Hans sjukskoterska (Eastwood) hittar ingen legitimation på honom och kallar honom bara John Doe (Rhys Meyers). Polisen brakar in på sjukhuset och anklagar John for att vara en seriemordare som har dodat flera unga kvinnor i trakten. Nar John ska foras till forhor lyckas han fly med hjalp av Diana, som ar saker på att han ar oskyldig. De kor till den senaste brottsplatsen for att hitta ledtrådar och svar som kan rentvå John från misstankarna. Den snalla sjukskoterskan tar reda på den skakande sanningen om Johns identitet och det nat av logner och svek som slutar i en sista kamp om hans overlevnad.

programme.title: Programmet fortsatter strax
programme.desc: Vi tar igen vår skonhetssomn! Stanna kvar for mer prisvard underhållning utvald av Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Hope Springs
programme.desc: Efter 30 års aktenskap; ett medelålders par deltar i en intensiv veckolång rådgivningssession for att jobba på deras forhållande.

programme.title: Instrument of War
programme.desc: Den amerikanska piloten Clair Cline blir nedskjuten och hamnar i fångenskap i norra Tyskland. En kamp tar slut, en annan tar vid – att hålla hoppet vid liv trots taggtråd och fortryck. Cline och hans medfångar måste hitta ett satt att hålla ihop, inte bara for att overleva utan aven for att utharda fångenskapen. Baserad på sanna handelser.

programme.title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
programme.desc: Valkomna till en katolsk flickskola i hjartat av Chicago, staden som ar hem for USA:s popularaste dansshow: Dance TV! Utbytesstudenten Janey Glenn ar ett nervvrak nar hon blir presenterad for sina fnittrande klasskompisar av stranga syster Katherine. Men hon blir snabbt van med Lynne och deras gemensamma intresse for dans gor att de blir eld och lågor nar det utlyses en tavling dar ett nytt danspar till Dance TV ska utses. Janey och Lynne beslutar sig for att provdansa, men deras foraldrar ar mer skeptiska.

programme.title: Death At A Funeral
programme.desc: En komisk vriden historia om en dysfunktionell familj som samlas for att sorja sin patriarks bortgång. Daniels far har just avlidit och det enda han vill ar att genomfora begravningen som planerat, vilket inte ar det lattaste med en galen familj på halsen. Brorsan ar mest intresserad av att ragga tjejer, en annan slakting ar overtygad om att fadern ar vid liv i kistan och en mystisk pillerburk dyker standigt upp. Denna dråpliga komedi i brittisk tradition bjuder på många overraskningar.

programme.title: Tillbaka till Yorkshire
programme.desc: Arthur Morrison får reda på att han har cancer och att han bara har några veckor kvar att leva. Hans vuxna son Blake reser till Yorkshire for att bo hos sin mamma i byn dar han vaxte upp. Nar Arthurs tillstånd forvarras ser Blake tillbaka på sitt forhållande med pappan. Han minns saker de gjort tillsammans, fortroligheten mellan dem och aven de forbistringar de haft. Nar fadern dor borjar Morrison fundera kring det band de haft. Han ger tydligt uttryck for motsattningar, frustration, karlek och forlust som alla ar delar i det komplicerade forhållande som finns mellan en far och hans son.

programme.title: Karlekens sloja (The Painted Veil)
programme.desc: Kitty ar en rastlos ung kvinna från overklassen som vill bort från sin familj. Nar hon traffar lakaren Walter Fane ser hon sin chans och gifter sig med honom. Tillsammans flyttar de till Shanghai dar Kitty blir foralskad i en annan man.

programme.title: Wild Target
programme.desc: En klumpig yrkesmordare blir foralskad i sitt offer och måste skydda henne från både sin egen organisation och polisen.

programme.title: Underligare an fiktion
programme.desc: En IRS-revisor finner sig plotsligt foremål for berattande som bara han kan hora: berattande som borjar påverka hela hans liv; från hans arbete; till hans karleksintresse; till sin dod.

programme.title: Long Story Short
programme.desc: Det har ar berattelsen om Ellen och hennes vanner, och deras mer eller mindre sjalvforvållat komplicerade karleksliv och romantiska drommar. Tre år av vannernas basta och samsta karlekshistorier sammanfattas och berattas genom åtta kapitel, som alla utspelar sig vid olika festliga tillstallningar. Gruppen kampar med iden om det perfekta forhållandet och måste omvardera vad sann karlek egentligen ar.

programme.title: The Wind
programme.desc: Under det sena 1800-talet flyttar en kvinna med sin man till den amerikanska vastern for att starta ett nytt liv. Men nar hon lamnas ensam i det tomma huset gor den hårda omgivningen och isoleringen henne orolig, eller rent ut sagt paranoid. Eller ar det faktiskt något verkligt, något overnaturligt som besitter de karga vidderna?

programme.title: Copycat
programme.desc: En ambitios detektiv forsoker dra en rattspsykolog ur sin sjalvpåtagna exil i hopp om att få hjalp att fånga en mordare som kopierar andra seriemordares brott.

programme.title: Cube
programme.desc: Sju framlingar med vitt skilda personlighetsegenskaper placeras ofrivilligt i en andlos labyrint med dodliga fallor.

programme.title: What We Did On Our Holiday
programme.desc: Doug (David Tennant) och Abi (Rosamund Pike) ar två helt vanliga foraldrar med tre charmiga men valdigt excentriska barn. Nar det hårda foraldralivet hotar deras mentala halsa och aktenskap så bestammer de sig for att ta med barnen på en resa till Skottland till ett stort slaktkalas och for att halsa på Dougs minst sagt knappa pappa Gordie (Billy Connolly). Det som skulle bli en forsoningsresa forvandlas snabbt till ett hysteriskt roligt socialt katastrofområde nar osamja,

programme.title: The Dresser
programme.desc: En odesdiger natt på en liten engelsk teater under andra varldskriget, satter en trupp med kringresande skådespelare upp Shakespeares "King Lear".

programme.title: Cha Cha Cha
programme.desc: Den alkoholiserade Matti (Matti Pellonpaa), som bor under broarna, ar på vag att arva en betydande summa pengar från sin amerikanska faster. Men mannen måste vara representativ under fasterns besok. Matti berattar om situationen for sin van som arbetar som bilhandlare, och denne foreslår en rollbyten mot ersattning.

programme.title: Promised Land
programme.desc: Det har dramat foljer två skolkamrater, Hancock och Danny, efter examen. Hancock och hans flickvan som ar en cheerleader ger sig ivag till medelklassens tillhåll utom rackhåll for Danny och hans psykotiska fru Bev.

programme.title: Saints Of War
programme.desc: Jersey, 1942. Hitler starker sitt grepp om Vasteuropa och Kanaloarna blir ockuperade. Tyskarna anvander Jersey som en bas dar krigsfångar slavarbetar i arbetslager och Jerseys invånare står infor en osaker framtid med radsla som frestar på humor och testar lojaliteter bland de tatt sammansvetsade i ons samhalle.

programme.title: Tillbaka till Yorkshire

programme.desc: 1924 samlade mediamogulen William Randolph Hearst några av varldens mest kanda personligheter for en resa med sin yacht som resulterade i ett mord som forblev olost.

programme.title: Staden Ember
programme.desc: Det har gått 200 år sedan den sista manniskan sokte skydd i den underjordiska staden Ember; men nu sviktar den stora generatorn.

programme.title: De arvlosa
programme.desc: Mika Kaurismaens forsta långfilm. Han skrev manuset tillsammans med sin bror Aki. "De arvlosa" ar en tidlos skildring av hur småskurken Manne, bonddrangen Harri och den vackra Veera kor en Volga genom de forsvinnande finlandska landskapen, med poliser och gangsters standigt på halarna. Den fartfyllda resan ackompanjeras av tidlosa låtar av bland annat Juice och Rauli Badding.

programme.title: Walking Tall
programme.desc: Nar det galler att skipa lag och ratt kan en man gora skillnad! Actionstjarnan Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson tar inga fångar nar han kampar for rattvisa och krossar korruption i denna berattelse om en man som tar stallning… och tar tillbaka sin stad!

programme.desc: Ett oidentifierat virus slår till mot Korea och regeringen forklarar undantagstillstånd. Staden Busan har avvarjt virusutbrottet - och de på tåget från Seoul måste nu kampa for sin egen overlevnad.

programme.title: Arlington Road
programme.desc: I denna tata thriller moter vi collegeprofessorn Michael Faraday vars fru, en FBI-agent, dodats av medlemmar av en hogerextrem terroristgrupp. Nar Michael blir van med sina nya grannar, Oliver och Cheryl Lang, får han snart anledning att misstanka att något inte står ratt till. Han borjar forska i deras forflutna, men inte utan risk for sitt liv.

programme.desc: The medieval treasury of Czech kings, Kutná Hora owes its prominence to its mines. In fact, the richness of the city’s silver mines was what saw it declared a royal city and made the seat of the Bohemian Royal Mint. As Rohan visits the city’s significant monuments such as a cathedral dedicated to the patron saint of all miners and the erstwhile central mint of the country, he finds out interesting stories about its mining and minting history.

programme.title: The Challenge of Leadership
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Bonsai Bad Boy - Season 1 - The Challenge of Leadership
programme.desc: After years of struggling Masashi Hirao feels he is finding clues to bonsai’s future, changing bonsai’s image of tired old men pruning trees. He has a radical idea to challenge tradition further at the 3-yearly international Setouchi Triennale, the largest art event in Japan. Masashi will stage an Avant Garde personal exhibition as well as a ground-breaking solo performance climaxing with a collaboration with a radical, anti-modernisation punk band, in direct contradiction of Masashi’s mission. It will be a bonsai showdown. Tradition and modernisation clashing head on. Is it possible to pursue change, and preserve tradition? Masashi is in unexplored territory.

programme.title: Saviour or Saboteur
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Bonsai Bad Boy - Season 1 - Saviour or Saboteur
programme.desc: Masashi Hirao is building an entirely new brand, and a new art form: performance bonsai. His quest to push boundaries brings fresh challenges, which come to the fore as he heads to Kuala Lumpur to team up with unconventional Malaysian realist painter, Lee Mar. Little goes to plan and the event strains both artist’s talents to the limit. But the challenge is nothing compared to the test when his radical approach wins him an invitation to the international Bonsai Without Borders Summit in China: 75 world-class Bonsai Masters from 35 countries. The bonsai bad boy has officially arrived on the world stage. It is the ultimate test in front of the most critical audience possible.

programme.title: Nature’s Heroes: Canada - Quebec - Part 2
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Earth from above - Season 4 - Nature’s Heroes: Canada - Quebec - Part 2
programme.desc: Canada is the second largest country in the world by land mass and contains amazing natural resources: 7% of the Earth’s drinking water is spread over the country’s thousands of lakes. Forests cover 45% of the territory. Yann Arthus-Bertrand goes off to discover these resources with those whose job it is to protect them. He takes a look at the ecological balance sheet of the world’s eighth-largest economic power.

programme.desc: Above all, these reports are an opportunity for Yann Arthus-Bertrand to take stock of the planet and denounce certain human behaviors that are at the root of dramatic, even irreversible, environmental and climatic degradation. Off to Tokyo, then Kenya, to an animal sanctuary. Then on to Mount Fuji to learn how to live there, and all the plastic that clogs up the seas. Reports will focus on everyday products, chosen for their destructive production practices for both people and the environment.

programme.title: The taste of bread

Her adventure will lead her through the Libourne region, then onwards to the North of France, the Ardèche, and the Aisne, where bakers have transformed bread into a powerful catalyst for social cohesion. While some individuals may avoid bread, particularly due to gluten-related concerns, others have chosen to reposition it at the forefront of the dining experience by championing its nutritional benefits. This commitment is shared by several chefs whom Julie will meet at the conclusion of her expedition.

programme.title: Juliette (Morbihan)
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 My Zen People - Season 4 - Juliette (Morbihan)
programme.desc: Juliette has long been aware of the delicate beauty of nature. For years she spent her life on the sea, organising regattas for the traditional sailboats that are famous in the French region of Morbihan. Her appreciation for the elements made for a smooth transition as she decided to leave the water behind and return to the earth. Learning to shape a ball of clay into a graceful and elegant object, she discovered a passion for ceramics. Today, she lives from her creations and makes pieces that reflect their surroundings, the stunning Gulf of Morbihan.

programme.title: Anna (Brittany)
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 My Zen People - Season 4 - Anna (Brittany)
programme.desc: Anna’s unusual background provided inspiration for her life change. Her career began as a wolf trainer for cinema and it was during these years that she developed her deep love for animals. After being tired of seeing them used as props and constantly in cages, she decided to leave the world of show business behind and start an eco-friendly sheep and goat pasture. To further share her passion for these gentle animals, Anna has opened a conservatory farm where visitors can experience first-hand the joys of being close to nature. She also makes amazing goat cheese!

programme.title: Cristina (Spain)
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 My Zen People - Season 4 - Cristina (Spain)
programme.desc: At 31 years old, the last thing Cristina expected when she went to see the doctor about a blocked ear was to leave the consultation with a diagnosis for Breast Cancer. This young and passionate sociologist decided to apply the same philosophy to her treatment as she did when surfing: when a wave crashes down on you, get up and try again. Through her healing journey she deepened her love for the ocean and also discovered the therapeutic capabilities of yoga for cancer patients. Today she shares her practice through surf and yoga retreats and is specialised in oncological yoga, helping others heal.

programme.title: Idoia (Spain)
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 My Zen People - Season 4 - Idoia (Spain)
programme.desc: Idoia thrives on weaving together the sources of inspiration that surround her. Heavily influenced by the natural beauty of her home region of Galicia, Spain, she creates unique woven pieces from diverse and beautiful materials. Idoia’s pieces represent her vision of a modern woman, drawing from the traditions and experiences of those who perfected the craft before her and also pushing to innovate and adapt her creations for the modern world. Her recent collaboration with luxury fashion house Loewe is a dream come true for this modern artisan.

programme.desc: "The end of oil" is the amazing story of a raw material which has revolutionized mans life in just a century. But today, oil reserves are depleting. In his crazy race for always more production, Man didnt manage to preserve this precious energy that took million years for the Earth to give out. To tell the adventure of oil, Yann Arthus-Bertrand and his team went to the United States, the country which depends the most on black gold. At the start of the 21st century, it is now urgent to realize that oil resources are limited. Its today that we have to act and get organized, in order to prepare the new era to come. While all our economies are based on the petrol barrels price, well...

programme.desc: If youre a nature enthusiast and a fan of outdoor cooking, the upcoming season is perfect for barbecue enthusiasts! Our journey will take us to Aube, nestled in the heart of the Brevonnes forest, and then to the Massif des Bauges, where grilling and snow create a unique combination. Afterward, well explore the Libournais region, where well uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area. Just a short distance from the vineyards, well arrive at another corner of Gironde, the Blaye region, where the cooking method remains consistent but features a distinctly local ingredient: eel.

programme.desc: Through the most magnificent images and astonishing human stories, Man is at the heart of the biodiversity that he must respect and preserve. We find ourselves in Kenya, where the biodiversity is particularly rich, in the Massaï Mara reserve. Then, in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the worrying disappearance of hippos from Lake Edward has unexpected consequences for the survival of fishermen. Then, in the sanctuary of life, the Pantanal region in Brazil, where millions of animal and plant species are teeming, some of the worlds great wetlands also in danger. In Tasmania, Yann Arthus-Bertrand fights against the napalm deforestation of one of the oldest and most beautiful forests...
